  function scheduleUtilitiesMarkerRefresh() {
    utilitiesLastSignature = "";
    ensureLegend();
    [0, 40, 100, 220, 450, 900, 1600].forEach(delay => {
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (!moduleActive || !isUtilitiesTab()) return;
        utilitiesLastSignature = "";
        ensureLegend();
        applyUtilitiesFlags();
      }, delay);
    });
  }
  function applyUtilitiesFlags() {
    ensureLegend();
    const { usersInOC, reqByUser } = mergedScans();
    const inOCSet = new Set(usersInOC.map(String));
    const notInOCSet = new Set(readNotInOC().xids.map(String));
    const entries = getArmoryItemEntries();
    const signature = entries.map(({ row, itemId }) => {
      const loanedLink = row.querySelector('.loaned a[href*="XID="]') || row.querySelector('a[href*="profiles.php?XID="]');

  function getAllTooltips() {
    return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[role="tooltip"], div[class*="tooltip"]'));
  }
  async function hoverAndGetTooltip(host) {
    if (!host) return null;
    const before = new Set(getAllTooltips().map(t => t.id).filter(Boolean));
    const hostCenter = rectCenter(host);
    dispatchSafeMouseEvent(host, "mouseenter");
    dispatchSafeMouseEvent(host, "mouseover");
    await sleep(TOOLTIP_OPEN_DELAY);
    const tipId = host.getAttribute("aria-describedby");
    let tip = tipId ? document.getElementById(tipId) : null;
    if (!tip) {
      const all = getAllTooltips();
      const candidates = all.filter(t => !t.id || !before.has(t.id));
      const pool = candidates.length ? candidates : all;
      if (pool.length) {
        tip = pool.sort((a, b) => dist(rectCenter(a), hostCenter) - dist(rectCenter(b), hostCenter))[0];
      }
    }
    dispatchSafeMouseEvent(host, "mouseleave");
    dispatchSafeMouseEvent(host, "mouseout");
    await sleep(TOOLTIP_CLOSE_DELAY);
    return tip ?? null;
  }
  function extractItemIdFromTooltip(tip) {
    if (!tip) return null;
    const text = (tip.textContent || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ");
    const html = tip.innerHTML || "";
    const aria = tip.querySelector("[aria-label]")?.getAttribute("aria-label") || "";
    const check = s => /used item\s*:|required item\s*:/i.test(s);
    if (!check(text) && !check(html) && !check(aria)) return null;
    const img = tip.querySelector('img[src*="/images/items/"]');
    return itemIdFromSrc(img?.getAttribute("src")) ?? (html + text).match(/\/images\/items\/(\d+)\//i)?.[1] ?? null;
  }
  function getCrimesStageLabel() {
    const { recruitingBtn, planningBtn, completedBtn, stageButtons } = getStageButtons();
    const btns = stageButtons?.length ? stageButtons : [recruitingBtn, planningBtn, completedBtn].filter(Boolean);
    const active = btns.find(isActiveStageButton) || btns.find(b => {
      const aria = String(b.getAttribute("aria-selected") || b.getAttribute("aria-current") || "").toLowerCase();
      return aria === "true" || aria === "page";
    });
    const txt = (active?.textContent || "").trim();
    if (/recruit/i.test(txt)) return "Recruiting";
    if (/plan/i.test(txt)) return "Planning";
    if (/compl/i.test(txt)) return "Completed";
    return txt || "Unknown";
  }
  function directSlotXid(slotRoot) {
    if(!slotRoot)return null;
    const link = slotRoot.querySelector(
      'a[href*="profiles.php?XID="],a[href*="/profiles.php?XID="]'
    );
    const fromLink=xidFromHref(link?.getAttribute("href"));
    if(fromLink)return fromLink;
    const dataElement=slotRoot.querySelector(
      "[data-user-id],[data-xid],[data-user]"
    );
    const dataValue=
      dataElement?.dataset?.userId ||
      dataElement?.dataset?.xid ||
      dataElement?.dataset?.user ||
      dataElement?.getAttribute("data-user-id") ||
      dataElement?.getAttribute("data-xid") ||
      dataElement?.getAttribute("data-user");
    if(/^\d+$/.test(String(dataValue||""))){
      return String(dataValue);
    }
    const html=slotRoot.innerHTML||"";
    const match=html.match(
      /(?:XID=|data-(?:user-id|xid)=["']?)(\d+)/i
    );
    return match?.[1]||null;
  }
  function directSlotItemId(slotRoot) {
    if (!slotRoot) return null;
    const images = Array.from(
      slotRoot.querySelectorAll('img[src*="/images/items/"]')
    );
    for (const image of images) {
      const id = itemIdFromSrc(image.getAttribute("src"));
      if (isAllowedItemId(id)) return String(id);
    }
    const dataItem = slotRoot.querySelector(
      "[data-itemid],[data-item-id]"
    );
    const dataId =
      dataItem?.dataset?.itemid ||
      dataItem?.dataset?.itemId ||
      dataItem?.getAttribute("data-itemid") ||
      dataItem?.getAttribute("data-item-id");
    return isAllowedItemId(dataId) ? String(dataId) : null;
  }
  async function scanCurrentCrimesStage() {
    const stage = getCrimesStageLabel();
    refreshNotInOCFromPage();
    if (stage !== "Recruiting" && stage !== "Planning") {
      return { ok: false, stage, reason: "Not on Recruiting/Planning" };
    }
    const usersInOC = new Set();
    const reqByUser = {};
    const roleByUser = {};
    const roots = findSlotRoots();
    for (const root of roots) {
      let xid = directSlotXid(root);
      if (!xid) {
        xid = await openMenuAndGetXid(root);
      }
      if (!xid) continue;
      usersInOC.add(xid);
      if (!reqByUser[xid]) {
        reqByUser[xid] = [];
      }

      const roleName =
        (
          root.querySelector(
            '[class*="title"], [class*="role"]'
          )?.textContent ||
          ""
        )
          .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
          .trim();

      if (roleName) {
        roleByUser[xid] = roleName;
      }

      let itemId = directSlotItemId(root);
      if (!itemId) {
        const hoverHost =
          root.querySelector(
            'button[class*="slotHeader"],[class*="slotHeader"]'
          ) ||
          root.querySelector('[aria-describedby]') ||
          root;
        const tip = await hoverAndGetTooltip(hoverHost);
        itemId = extractItemIdFromTooltip(tip);
      }
      if (isAllowedItemId(itemId)) {
        const sid = String(itemId);
        if (!reqByUser[xid].includes(sid)) {
          reqByUser[xid].push(sid);
        }
      }
    }
    if (!roots.length || !usersInOC.size) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        stage,
        reason: "No OC role slots found"
      };
    }
    const scan = {
      stage,
      ts: now(),
      source: "dom",
      usersInOC: [...usersInOC],
      reqByUser,
      missingByUser: {},
      roleByUser
    };
    writeScan(scan);
    sessionScanState[stage] = true;
    log("Scan saved:", { stage, users: scan.usersInOC.length });
    return { ok: true, stage, scan };
  }

    `;

  }
  function rowFromImgWrap(imgWrap) {
    let el = imgWrap.closest("li") || imgWrap.parentElement;
    for (let i = 0; i < 10 && el; i++) {
      const hasText = (el.textContent || "").trim().length > 0;
      const hasOptions = !!el.querySelector?.(".show-option-icon, .item-action, .give, .loan, .retrieve, [class*='options']");
      const r = el.getBoundingClientRect?.();
      if (hasText && hasOptions) return el;
      if (hasOptions && r?.height >= 34 && r?.height <= 160) return el;
      el = el.parentElement;
    }
    return imgWrap.closest("div") || imgWrap.parentElement || imgWrap;
  }
  function clearLoanedFlags() {
    document.querySelectorAll(".sakalux-oco-row").forEach(n => {

  function getArmoryItemEntries() {
    const entries = [];
    const seenRows = new Set();
    let candidates = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('div.img-wrap[data-itemid][data-armoryid], [data-itemid][data-armoryid]'));
    if (!candidates.length) {
      candidates = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('div.img-wrap[data-itemid], img[src*="/images/items/"]'));
    }
    for (const el of candidates) {
      const row = rowFromImgWrap(el);
      if (!row || seenRows.has(row)) continue;
      const rowText = (row.textContent || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
      const looksLikeArmoryRow = /\b(Give|Loan|Retrieve|Available)\b/i.test(rowText) || !!row.querySelector('a.retrieve, a.give, a.loan, [class*="loaned"]');
      if (!looksLikeArmoryRow) continue;
      const itemId = String(
        el.dataset?.itemid ||
        el.closest?.('[data-itemid]')?.dataset?.itemid ||
        itemIdFromSrc(el.getAttribute?.("src")) ||
        itemIdFromSrc(el.querySelector?.('img[src*="/images/items/"]')?.getAttribute("src")) ||
        ""
      );
      if (!isAllowedItemId(itemId)) continue;
      entries.push({ row, itemId });
      seenRows.add(row);
    }
    return entries;
  }
  function addRowPill(row, anchor, state, text) {

    pill.className = "sakalux-oco-pill";
    pill.dataset.state = state;
    pill.textContent = text;
    if (anchor) anchor.insertAdjacentElement("afterend", pill);
    else row.appendChild(pill);
  }

      btn?.textContent ||

    ).replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim().toLowerCase();

  function isStageButton(btn) {
    const t = stageButtonText(btn);
    return /\b(recruiting|recruit|planning|plan|completed|complete)\b/i.test(t);
  }
  function isActiveStageButton(btn) {
    if (!btn) return false;
    const cls = String(btn.className || "").toLowerCase();
    const ariaSelected = String(btn.getAttribute?.("aria-selected") || "").toLowerCase();
    const ariaCurrent = String(btn.getAttribute?.("aria-current") || "").toLowerCase();
    return cls.includes("active") || cls.includes("selected") || ariaSelected === "true" || ariaCurrent === "page";
  }
  function candidateStageButtons() {
    const selectors = [
      "div.buttonsContainer___aClaa button",
      "button",
      "[role='tab']",
      "[role='button']"
    ];
    return [...new Set(selectors.flatMap(sel => Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(sel))))]
      .filter(el => el && isStageButton(el));
  }
  function commonStageBarFromButtons(buttons) {
    const arr = (buttons || []).filter(Boolean);
    if (!arr.length) return null;
    const counts = new Map();
    for (const btn of arr) {
      let el = btn.parentElement;
      for (let i = 0; i < 8 && el && el !== document.body; i++, el = el.parentElement) {
        counts.set(el, (counts.get(el) || 0) + 1);
      }
    }
    let best = null;
    let bestScore = 0;
    for (const [el, count] of counts.entries()) {
      if (count < 2) continue;
      const r = el.getBoundingClientRect?.();
      const score = (count * 1000) - ((r?.height || 0) + (r?.width || 0) / 100);
      if (score > bestScore) {
        best = el;
        bestScore = score;
      }
    }
    return best || arr[0].parentElement || null;
  }
  function getTabsBar() {
    const oldBar = document.querySelector("div.buttonsContainer___aClaa");
    if (oldBar && oldBar.querySelector("button")) return oldBar;
    const buttons = candidateStageButtons();
    return commonStageBarFromButtons(buttons);
  }
  function getStageButtons() {
    const bar = getTabsBar();
    const pool = bar
      ? Array.from(bar.querySelectorAll("button, [role='tab'], [role='button']")).filter(isStageButton)
      : candidateStageButtons();
    let recruitingBtn = null;
    let planningBtn = null;
    let completedBtn = null;
    for (const btn of pool) {
      const t = stageButtonText(btn);
      if (!recruitingBtn && /recruit/.test(t)) recruitingBtn = btn;
      if (!planningBtn && /plan/.test(t)) planningBtn = btn;
      if (!completedBtn && /complet/.test(t)) completedBtn = btn;
    }
    return { recruitingBtn, planningBtn, completedBtn, stageButtons: pool };
  }
  async function handleOcStageEntry(
    stage = getCrimesStageLabel()
  ) {
    if (
      !moduleActive ||
      !isCrimesTab() ||
      (
        stage !== "Recruiting" &&
        stage !== "Planning"
      )
    ) {
      return;
    }

    if (stage === lastObservedOcStage) {
      return;
    }

    // Mark entry immediately so MutationObserver rerenders cannot
    // schedule duplicate API calls while this request is in flight.
    lastObservedOcStage = stage;

    markStageScanRequired(stage);
    updateStageVisuals();

    const statusEl =
      document.querySelector(
        ".sakalux-oco-scan-status"
      );

    if (statusEl) {
      statusEl.classList.remove(
        "is-success",
        "is-error"
      );
      statusEl.classList.add(
        "is-scanning"
      );
      statusEl.textContent =
        `Scanning ${stage} members and roles...`;
      statusEl.title =
        `Scanning every ${stage} OC member, role and required item...`;
    }

    const result =
      await scanAvailableCrimesViaApi(
        stage,
        true
      );

    if (
      result?.ok &&
      result?.stage === stage
    ) {
      markStageScanComplete(stage);
      updateStageVisuals();
      itemTick();
      utilitiesLastSignature = "";

      if (statusEl) {
        flashScanStatus(
          statusEl,
          sessionScanSummary(),
          "success"
        );
      }
      return;
    }

    if (statusEl) {
      flashScanStatus(
        statusEl,
        result?.reason ||
          "API refresh failed",
        "error",
        2200
      );
    }
  }

  function bindStageAutoRescan() {
    const {
      recruitingBtn,
      planningBtn
    } = getStageButtons();

    for (const button of [
      recruitingBtn,
      planningBtn
    ]) {
      if (
        !button ||
        button.dataset
          .sakaluxOcoAutoRescanBound === "1"
      ) {
        continue;
      }

      button.dataset
        .sakaluxOcoAutoRescanBound = "1";

      button.addEventListener(
        "click",
        () => {
          window.setTimeout(() => {
            handleOcStageEntry(
              getCrimesStageLabel()
            ).catch(error => {
              log(
                "OC stage-entry scan failed:",
                error
              );
            });
          }, 120);
        }
      );
    }
  }

  function updateStageVisuals() {
    const { recruitingBtn, planningBtn } = getStageButtons();
    const persistentState =
      readStageScanState();

    sessionScanState.Recruiting =
      !!persistentState.Recruiting.completed;
    sessionScanState.Planning =
      !!persistentState.Planning.completed;

    if (
      sessionScanState.Recruiting &&
      sessionScanState.Planning
    ) {
      utilitiesLastSignature = "";
    }
    if (recruitingBtn) {
      recruitingBtn.classList.toggle("sakalux-oco-stage-scanned", !!sessionScanState.Recruiting);
      recruitingBtn.title = sessionScanState.Recruiting
        ? "Recruiting - Scan Complete"
        : "Recruiting - Scan Required";
    }
    if (planningBtn) {
      planningBtn.classList.toggle("sakalux-oco-stage-scanned", !!sessionScanState.Planning);
      planningBtn.title = sessionScanState.Planning
        ? "Planning - Scan Complete"
        : "Planning - Scan Required";
    }
  }

  function flashScanStatus(el, text, type, holdMs = 1600) {
    if (!el) return;
    clearTimeout(el._sakaluxTimer);
    el.classList.remove("is-success", "is-error", "is-scanning");
    if (type === "success") {
      renderScanStatus(el);
      el.classList.add("is-success");
    } else if (type === "error") {
      el.textContent = text;
      el.title = sessionScanTooltip();
      el.classList.add("is-error");
    } else {
      el.textContent = text;
      el.title = sessionScanTooltip();
    }
    el._sakaluxTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      renderScanStatus(el);
    }, holdMs);
  }

  function isActiveStageButton(btn) {
    if (!btn) return false;
    const cls = String(btn.className || "").toLowerCase();
    const ariaSelected = String(btn.getAttribute?.("aria-selected") || "").toLowerCase();
    const ariaCurrent = String(btn.getAttribute?.("aria-current") || "").toLowerCase();
    return cls.includes("active") || cls.includes("selected") || ariaSelected === "true" || ariaCurrent === "page";
  }
  function candidateStageButtons() {
    const selectors = [
      "div.buttonsContainer___aClaa button",
      "button",
      "[role='tab']",
      "[role='button']"
    ];
    return [...new Set(selectors.flatMap(sel => Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(sel))))]
      .filter(el => el && isStageButton(el));
  }
  function commonStageBarFromButtons(buttons) {
    const arr = (buttons || []).filter(Boolean);
    if (!arr.length) return null;
    const counts = new Map();
    for (const btn of arr) {
      let el = btn.parentElement;
      for (let i = 0; i < 8 && el && el !== document.body; i++, el = el.parentElement) {
        counts.set(el, (counts.get(el) || 0) + 1);
      }
    }
    let best = null;
    let bestScore = 0;
    for (const [el, count] of counts.entries()) {
      if (count < 2) continue;
      const r = el.getBoundingClientRect?.();
      const score = (count * 1000) - ((r?.height || 0) + (r?.width || 0) / 100);
      if (score > bestScore) {
        best = el;
        bestScore = score;
      }
    }
    return best || arr[0].parentElement || null;
  }
  function getTabsBar() {
    const oldBar = document.querySelector("div.buttonsContainer___aClaa");
    if (oldBar && oldBar.querySelector("button")) return oldBar;
    const buttons = candidateStageButtons();
    return commonStageBarFromButtons(buttons);
  }
  function getStageButtons() {
    const bar = getTabsBar();
    const pool = bar
      ? Array.from(bar.querySelectorAll("button, [role='tab'], [role='button']")).filter(isStageButton)
      : candidateStageButtons();
    let recruitingBtn = null;
    let planningBtn = null;
    let completedBtn = null;
    for (const btn of pool) {
      const t = stageButtonText(btn);
      if (!recruitingBtn && /recruit/.test(t)) recruitingBtn = btn;
      if (!planningBtn && /plan/.test(t)) planningBtn = btn;
      if (!completedBtn && /complet/.test(t)) completedBtn = btn;
    }
    return { recruitingBtn, planningBtn, completedBtn, stageButtons: pool };
  }
  async function handleOcStageEntry(
    stage = getCrimesStageLabel()
  ) {
    if (
      !moduleActive ||
      !isCrimesTab() ||
      (
        stage !== "Recruiting" &&
        stage !== "Planning"
      )
    ) {
      return;
    }

    if (stage === lastObservedOcStage) {
      return;
    }

    // Mark entry immediately so MutationObserver rerenders cannot
    // schedule duplicate API calls while this request is in flight.
    lastObservedOcStage = stage;

    markStageScanRequired(stage);
    updateStageVisuals();

    const statusEl =
      document.querySelector(
        ".sakalux-oco-scan-status"
      );

    if (statusEl) {
      statusEl.classList.remove(
        "is-success",
        "is-error"
      );
      statusEl.classList.add(
        "is-scanning"
      );
      statusEl.textContent =
        `Scanning ${stage} members and roles...`;
      statusEl.title =
        `Scanning every ${stage} OC member, role and required item...`;
    }

    const result =
      await scanAvailableCrimesViaApi(
        stage,
        true
      );

    if (
      result?.ok &&
      result?.stage === stage
    ) {
      markStageScanComplete(stage);
      updateStageVisuals();
      itemTick();
      utilitiesLastSignature = "";

      if (statusEl) {
        flashScanStatus(
          statusEl,
          sessionScanSummary(),
          "success"
        );
      }
      return;
    }

    if (statusEl) {
      flashScanStatus(
        statusEl,
        result?.reason ||
          "API refresh failed",
        "error",
        2200
      );
    }
  }

  function bindStageAutoRescan() {
    const {
      recruitingBtn,
      planningBtn
    } = getStageButtons();

    for (const button of [
      recruitingBtn,
      planningBtn
    ]) {
      if (
        !button ||
        button.dataset
          .sakaluxOcoAutoRescanBound === "1"
      ) {
        continue;
      }

      button.dataset
        .sakaluxOcoAutoRescanBound = "1";

      button.addEventListener(
        "click",
        () => {
          window.setTimeout(() => {
            handleOcStageEntry(
              getCrimesStageLabel()
            ).catch(error => {
              log(
                "OC stage-entry scan failed:",
                error
              );
            });
          }, 120);
        }
      );
    }
  }

  function updateStageVisuals() {
    const { recruitingBtn, planningBtn } = getStageButtons();
    const persistentState =
      readStageScanState();

    sessionScanState.Recruiting =
      !!persistentState.Recruiting.completed;
    sessionScanState.Planning =
      !!persistentState.Planning.completed;

    if (
      sessionScanState.Recruiting &&
      sessionScanState.Planning
    ) {
      utilitiesLastSignature = "";
    }
    if (recruitingBtn) {
      recruitingBtn.classList.toggle("sakalux-oco-stage-scanned", !!sessionScanState.Recruiting);
      recruitingBtn.title = sessionScanState.Recruiting
        ? "Recruiting - Scan Complete"
        : "Recruiting - Scan Required";
    }
    if (planningBtn) {
      planningBtn.classList.toggle("sakalux-oco-stage-scanned", !!sessionScanState.Planning);
      planningBtn.title = sessionScanState.Planning
        ? "Planning - Scan Complete"
        : "Planning - Scan Required";
    }
  }
  function renderScanStatus(el) {
    if (!el) return;
    el.classList.remove("is-success", "is-error", "is-scanning");
    el.innerHTML = sessionScanStatusHTML();
    el.title = sessionScanTooltip();
  }
  function flashScanStatus(el, text, type, holdMs = 1600) {
    if (!el) return;
    clearTimeout(el._sakaluxTimer);
    el.classList.remove("is-success", "is-error", "is-scanning");
    if (type === "success") {
      renderScanStatus(el);
      el.classList.add("is-success");
    } else if (type === "error") {
      el.textContent = text;
      el.title = sessionScanTooltip();
      el.classList.add("is-error");
    } else {
      el.textContent = text;
      el.title = sessionScanTooltip();
    }
    el._sakaluxTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      renderScanStatus(el);
    }, holdMs);
  }
  function pulseScanBtn(btn) {
    if (!btn) return;
    btn.classList.remove("sakalux-oco-pulse");
    void btn.offsetWidth;
    btn.classList.add("sakalux-oco-pulse");
  }
  function ensureScanButton() {
    const bar = getTabsBar();
    if (!bar) return;
    if (bar.querySelector(".sakalux-oco-btn-wrap")) {
      const statusEl = bar.querySelector(".sakalux-oco-scan-status");
      if (statusEl && !statusEl.classList.contains("is-success") && !statusEl.classList.contains("is-error") && !statusEl.classList.contains("is-scanning")) {
        renderScanStatus(statusEl);
      }
      updateStageVisuals();
      bindStageAutoRescan();
      return;
    }
    const cs = getComputedStyle(bar);
    if (cs.display !== "flex") {
      bar.style.display = "flex";
      bar.style.alignItems = "center";
    }
    if (!bar.style.gap) bar.style.gap = "6px";
    const wrap = document.createElement("div");
    wrap.className = "sakalux-oco-btn-wrap";
    wrap.innerHTML = `
      <button
        id="sakalux-oco-scan-btn"
        class="sakalux-oco-scan-btn"
        type="button"
        title="Scan this OC stage - scan both Recruiting and Planning for full results."
        aria-label="Scan OC stage"
      >
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">
          <path d="M10.5 4a6.5 6.5 0 1 0 4.06 11.58l3.43 3.43 1.41-1.41-3.43-3.43A6.5 6.5 0 0 0 10.5 4Zm0 2a4.5 4.5 0 1 1 0 9 4.5 4.5 0 0 1 0-9Z"/>
        </svg>
        <span>Scan</span>
      </button>
      <span class="sakalux-oco-scan-status" title="${sessionScanTooltip()}">${sessionScanStatusHTML()}</span>
    `;
    bar.appendChild(wrap);
    const btn = wrap.querySelector(".sakalux-oco-scan-btn");
    const statusEl = wrap.querySelector(".sakalux-oco-scan-status");
    btn.addEventListener("click", async () => {
      btn.disabled = true;
      statusEl.classList.remove("is-success", "is-error");
      statusEl.classList.add("is-scanning");
      statusEl.textContent = "Scanning…";
      statusEl.title = "Scanning current OC stage…";
      try {
        const manualStage =
          getCrimesStageLabel();

        if (
          manualStage === "Recruiting" ||
          manualStage === "Planning"
        ) {
          markStageScanRequired(
            manualStage
          );
          updateStageVisuals();
        }

        let result =
          await scanAvailableCrimesViaApi(
            manualStage,
            true
          );

        if (!result?.ok) {
          result =
            await scanCurrentCrimesStage();
        }

        if (!result.ok) {
          flashScanStatus(
            statusEl,
            result.reason || "Go to Recruiting/Planning",
            "error",
            2200
          );
        } else {
          const visibleStage =
            getCrimesStageLabel();

          if (
            visibleStage === "Recruiting" ||
            visibleStage === "Planning"
          ) {
            markStageScanComplete(
              visibleStage
            );
          }

          updateStageVisuals();
          pulseScanBtn(btn);
          itemTick();
          flashScanStatus(statusEl, sessionScanSummary(), "success");
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("[SakaLuX OC Role Match + Readiness] Scan error:", err);
        flashScanStatus(statusEl, "Scan failed", "error", 2200);
      } finally {
        btn.disabled = false;
      }
    });
    log("Scan button injected.");
    updateStageVisuals();
    bindStageAutoRescan();
  }
  function startIntelReadyPoll() {
    if (!moduleActive || intelReadyPoll) return;
    intelReadyPollStartedAt = Date.now();
    intelReadyPoll = setInterval(() => {
      if (!isCrimesTab()) {
        clearInterval(intelReadyPoll);
        intelReadyPoll = null;
        return;
      }
      const cardsReady = getNotInvolvedCards().length > 0;
      if (!onPageUpdate._intelLoadedThisPage && cardsReady) {
        onPageUpdate();
      }
      if (
        onPageUpdate._intelLoadedThisPage ||
        (Date.now() - intelReadyPollStartedAt) > 30000
      ) {
        clearInterval(intelReadyPoll);
        intelReadyPoll = null;
      }
    }, 500);
  }
  function onPageUpdate() {
    if (!moduleActive) return;
    evaluate();
    document.getElementById("sakalux-oco-tab-gear")?.remove();

        visibleStage === "Recruiting" ||
        visibleStage === "Planning"

          visibleStage

            err
          );
        });

  function candidateStageButtons() {
    const selectors = [
      "div.buttonsContainer___aClaa button",
      "button",
      "[role='tab']",
      "[role='button']"
    ];
    return [...new Set(selectors.flatMap(sel => Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(sel))))]
      .filter(el => el && isStageButton(el));
  }
  function commonStageBarFromButtons(buttons) {
    const arr = (buttons || []).filter(Boolean);
    if (!arr.length) return null;
    const counts = new Map();
    for (const btn of arr) {
      let el = btn.parentElement;
      for (let i = 0; i < 8 && el && el !== document.body; i++, el = el.parentElement) {
        counts.set(el, (counts.get(el) || 0) + 1);
      }
    }
    let best = null;
    let bestScore = 0;
    for (const [el, count] of counts.entries()) {
      if (count < 2) continue;
      const r = el.getBoundingClientRect?.();
      const score = (count * 1000) - ((r?.height || 0) + (r?.width || 0) / 100);
      if (score > bestScore) {
        best = el;
        bestScore = score;
      }
    }
    return best || arr[0].parentElement || null;
  }
  function getTabsBar() {
    const oldBar = document.querySelector("div.buttonsContainer___aClaa");
    if (oldBar && oldBar.querySelector("button")) return oldBar;
    const buttons = candidateStageButtons();
    return commonStageBarFromButtons(buttons);
  }
  function getStageButtons() {
    const bar = getTabsBar();
    const pool = bar
      ? Array.from(bar.querySelectorAll("button, [role='tab'], [role='button']")).filter(isStageButton)
      : candidateStageButtons();
    let recruitingBtn = null;
    let planningBtn = null;
    let completedBtn = null;
    for (const btn of pool) {
      const t = stageButtonText(btn);
      if (!recruitingBtn && /recruit/.test(t)) recruitingBtn = btn;
      if (!planningBtn && /plan/.test(t)) planningBtn = btn;
      if (!completedBtn && /complet/.test(t)) completedBtn = btn;
    }
    return { recruitingBtn, planningBtn, completedBtn, stageButtons: pool };
  }
  async function handleOcStageEntry(
    stage = getCrimesStageLabel()
  ) {
    if (
      !moduleActive ||
      !isCrimesTab() ||
      (
        stage !== "Recruiting" &&
        stage !== "Planning"
      )
    ) {
      return;
    }

    if (stage === lastObservedOcStage) {
      return;
    }

    // Mark entry immediately so MutationObserver rerenders cannot
    // schedule duplicate API calls while this request is in flight.
    lastObservedOcStage = stage;

    markStageScanRequired(stage);
    updateStageVisuals();

    const statusEl =
      document.querySelector(
        ".sakalux-oco-scan-status"
      );

    if (statusEl) {
      statusEl.classList.remove(
        "is-success",
        "is-error"
      );
      statusEl.classList.add(
        "is-scanning"
      );
      statusEl.textContent =
        `Scanning ${stage} members and roles...`;
      statusEl.title =
        `Scanning every ${stage} OC member, role and required item...`;
    }

    const result =
      await scanAvailableCrimesViaApi(
        stage,
        true
      );

    if (
      result?.ok &&
      result?.stage === stage
    ) {
      markStageScanComplete(stage);
      updateStageVisuals();
      itemTick();
      utilitiesLastSignature = "";

      if (statusEl) {
        flashScanStatus(
          statusEl,
          sessionScanSummary(),
          "success"
        );
      }
      return;
    }

    if (statusEl) {
      flashScanStatus(
        statusEl,
        result?.reason ||
          "API refresh failed",
        "error",
        2200
      );
    }
  }

  function bindStageAutoRescan() {
    const {
      recruitingBtn,
      planningBtn
    } = getStageButtons();

    for (const button of [
      recruitingBtn,
      planningBtn
    ]) {
      if (
        !button ||
        button.dataset
          .sakaluxOcoAutoRescanBound === "1"
      ) {
        continue;
      }

      button.dataset
        .sakaluxOcoAutoRescanBound = "1";

      button.addEventListener(
        "click",
        () => {
          window.setTimeout(() => {
            handleOcStageEntry(
              getCrimesStageLabel()
            ).catch(error => {
              log(
                "OC stage-entry scan failed:",
                error
              );
            });
          }, 120);
        }
      );
    }
  }

  function updateStageVisuals() {
    const { recruitingBtn, planningBtn } = getStageButtons();
    const persistentState =
      readStageScanState();

    sessionScanState.Recruiting =
      !!persistentState.Recruiting.completed;
    sessionScanState.Planning =
      !!persistentState.Planning.completed;

    if (
      sessionScanState.Recruiting &&
      sessionScanState.Planning
    ) {
      utilitiesLastSignature = "";
    }
    if (recruitingBtn) {
      recruitingBtn.classList.toggle("sakalux-oco-stage-scanned", !!sessionScanState.Recruiting);
      recruitingBtn.title = sessionScanState.Recruiting
        ? "Recruiting - Scan Complete"
        : "Recruiting - Scan Required";
    }
    if (planningBtn) {
      planningBtn.classList.toggle("sakalux-oco-stage-scanned", !!sessionScanState.Planning);
      planningBtn.title = sessionScanState.Planning
        ? "Planning - Scan Complete"
        : "Planning - Scan Required";
    }
  }
  function renderScanStatus(el) {
    if (!el) return;
    el.classList.remove("is-success", "is-error", "is-scanning");
    el.innerHTML = sessionScanStatusHTML();
    el.title = sessionScanTooltip();
  }
  function flashScanStatus(el, text, type, holdMs = 1600) {
    if (!el) return;
    clearTimeout(el._sakaluxTimer);
    el.classList.remove("is-success", "is-error", "is-scanning");
    if (type === "success") {
      renderScanStatus(el);
      el.classList.add("is-success");
    } else if (type === "error") {
      el.textContent = text;
      el.title = sessionScanTooltip();
      el.classList.add("is-error");
    } else {
      el.textContent = text;
      el.title = sessionScanTooltip();
    }
    el._sakaluxTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      renderScanStatus(el);
    }, holdMs);
  }
  function pulseScanBtn(btn) {
    if (!btn) return;
    btn.classList.remove("sakalux-oco-pulse");
    void btn.offsetWidth;
    btn.classList.add("sakalux-oco-pulse");
  }
  function ensureScanButton() {
    const bar = getTabsBar();
    if (!bar) return;
    if (bar.querySelector(".sakalux-oco-btn-wrap")) {
      const statusEl = bar.querySelector(".sakalux-oco-scan-status");
      if (statusEl && !statusEl.classList.contains("is-success") && !statusEl.classList.contains("is-error") && !statusEl.classList.contains("is-scanning")) {
        renderScanStatus(statusEl);
      }
      updateStageVisuals();
      bindStageAutoRescan();
      return;
    }
    const cs = getComputedStyle(bar);
    if (cs.display !== "flex") {
      bar.style.display = "flex";
      bar.style.alignItems = "center";
    }
    if (!bar.style.gap) bar.style.gap = "6px";
    const wrap = document.createElement("div");
    wrap.className = "sakalux-oco-btn-wrap";
    wrap.innerHTML = `
      <button
        id="sakalux-oco-scan-btn"
        class="sakalux-oco-scan-btn"
        type="button"
        title="Scan this OC stage - scan both Recruiting and Planning for full results."
        aria-label="Scan OC stage"
      >
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">
          <path d="M10.5 4a6.5 6.5 0 1 0 4.06 11.58l3.43 3.43 1.41-1.41-3.43-3.43A6.5 6.5 0 0 0 10.5 4Zm0 2a4.5 4.5 0 1 1 0 9 4.5 4.5 0 0 1 0-9Z"/>
        </svg>
        <span>Scan</span>
      </button>
      <span class="sakalux-oco-scan-status" title="${sessionScanTooltip()}">${sessionScanStatusHTML()}</span>
    `;
    bar.appendChild(wrap);
    const btn = wrap.querySelector(".sakalux-oco-scan-btn");
    const statusEl = wrap.querySelector(".sakalux-oco-scan-status");
    btn.addEventListener("click", async () => {
      btn.disabled = true;
      statusEl.classList.remove("is-success", "is-error");
      statusEl.classList.add("is-scanning");
      statusEl.textContent = "Scanning…";
      statusEl.title = "Scanning current OC stage…";
      try {
        const manualStage =
          getCrimesStageLabel();

        if (
          manualStage === "Recruiting" ||
          manualStage === "Planning"
        ) {
          markStageScanRequired(
            manualStage
          );
          updateStageVisuals();
        }

        let result =
          await scanAvailableCrimesViaApi(
            manualStage,
            true
          );

        if (!result?.ok) {
          result =
            await scanCurrentCrimesStage();
        }

        if (!result.ok) {
          flashScanStatus(
            statusEl,
            result.reason || "Go to Recruiting/Planning",
            "error",
            2200
          );
        } else {
          const visibleStage =

          flashScanStatus(statusEl, sessionScanSummary(), "success");
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("[SakaLuX OC Role Match + Readiness] Scan error:", err);
        flashScanStatus(statusEl, "Scan failed", "error", 2200);
      } finally {
        btn.disabled = false;

  function startIntelReadyPoll() {
    if (!moduleActive || intelReadyPoll) return;
    intelReadyPollStartedAt = Date.now();
    intelReadyPoll = setInterval(() => {
      if (!isCrimesTab()) {
        clearInterval(intelReadyPoll);
        intelReadyPoll = null;

      }
      const cardsReady = getNotInvolvedCards().length > 0;
      if (!onPageUpdate._intelLoadedThisPage && cardsReady) {
        onPageUpdate();

      if (
        onPageUpdate._intelLoadedThisPage ||
        (Date.now() - intelReadyPollStartedAt) > 30000
      ) {
        clearInterval(intelReadyPoll);
        intelReadyPoll = null;
      }
    }, 500);
  }

  function candidateStageButtons() {
    const selectors = [
      "div.buttonsContainer___aClaa button",
      "button",
      "[role='tab']",
      "[role='button']"
    ];
    return [...new Set(selectors.flatMap(sel => Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(sel))))]
      .filter(el => el && isStageButton(el));
  }
  function commonStageBarFromButtons(buttons) {
    const arr = (buttons || []).filter(Boolean);
    if (!arr.length) return null;
    const counts = new Map();
    for (const btn of arr) {
      let el = btn.parentElement;
      for (let i = 0; i < 8 && el && el !== document.body; i++, el = el.parentElement) {
        counts.set(el, (counts.get(el) || 0) + 1);
      }
    }
    let best = null;
    let bestScore = 0;
    for (const [el, count] of counts.entries()) {
      if (count < 2) continue;
      const r = el.getBoundingClientRect?.();
      const score = (count * 1000) - ((r?.height || 0) + (r?.width || 0) / 100);
      if (score > bestScore) {
        best = el;
        bestScore = score;
      }
    }
    return best || arr[0].parentElement || null;
  }
  function getTabsBar() {
    const oldBar = document.querySelector("div.buttonsContainer___aClaa");
    if (oldBar && oldBar.querySelector("button")) return oldBar;
    const buttons = candidateStageButtons();
    return commonStageBarFromButtons(buttons);
  }
  function getStageButtons() {
    const bar = getTabsBar();
    const pool = bar
      ? Array.from(bar.querySelectorAll("button, [role='tab'], [role='button']")).filter(isStageButton)
      : candidateStageButtons();
    let recruitingBtn = null;
    let planningBtn = null;
    let completedBtn = null;
    for (const btn of pool) {
      const t = stageButtonText(btn);
      if (!recruitingBtn && /recruit/.test(t)) recruitingBtn = btn;
      if (!planningBtn && /plan/.test(t)) planningBtn = btn;
      if (!completedBtn && /complet/.test(t)) completedBtn = btn;
    }
    return { recruitingBtn, planningBtn, completedBtn, stageButtons: pool };
  }
  async function handleOcStageEntry(
    stage = getCrimesStageLabel()
  ) {
    if (
      !moduleActive ||
      !isCrimesTab() ||
      (
        stage !== "Recruiting" &&
        stage !== "Planning"
      )
    ) {
      return;
    }

    if (stage === lastObservedOcStage) {
      return;
    }

    // Mark entry immediately so MutationObserver rerenders cannot
    // schedule duplicate API calls while this request is in flight.
    lastObservedOcStage = stage;

    markStageScanRequired(stage);
    updateStageVisuals();

    const statusEl =
      document.querySelector(
        ".sakalux-oco-scan-status"
      );

    if (statusEl) {
      statusEl.classList.remove(
        "is-success",
        "is-error"
      );
      statusEl.classList.add(
        "is-scanning"
      );
      statusEl.textContent =
        `Scanning ${stage} members and roles...`;
      statusEl.title =
        `Scanning every ${stage} OC member, role and required item...`;
    }

    const result =
      await scanAvailableCrimesViaApi(
        stage,
        true
      );

    if (
      result?.ok &&
      result?.stage === stage
    ) {
      markStageScanComplete(stage);
      updateStageVisuals();
      itemTick();
      utilitiesLastSignature = "";

      if (statusEl) {
        flashScanStatus(
          statusEl,
          sessionScanSummary(),
          "success"
        );
      }
      return;
    }

    if (statusEl) {
      flashScanStatus(
        statusEl,
        result?.reason ||
          "API refresh failed",
        "error",
        2200
      );
    }
  }

  function bindStageAutoRescan() {
    const {
      recruitingBtn,
      planningBtn
    } = getStageButtons();

    for (const button of [
      recruitingBtn,
      planningBtn
    ]) {
      if (
        !button ||
        button.dataset
          .sakaluxOcoAutoRescanBound === "1"
      ) {
        continue;
      }

      button.dataset
        .sakaluxOcoAutoRescanBound = "1";

      button.addEventListener(
        "click",
        () => {
          window.setTimeout(() => {
            handleOcStageEntry(
              getCrimesStageLabel()
            ).catch(error => {
              log(
                "OC stage-entry scan failed:",
                error
              );
            });
          }, 120);
        }
      );
    }
  }

  function updateStageVisuals() {
    const { recruitingBtn, planningBtn } = getStageButtons();
    const persistentState =
      readStageScanState();

    sessionScanState.Recruiting =
      !!persistentState.Recruiting.completed;
    sessionScanState.Planning =
      !!persistentState.Planning.completed;

    if (
      sessionScanState.Recruiting &&
      sessionScanState.Planning
    ) {
      utilitiesLastSignature = "";
    }
    if (recruitingBtn) {
      recruitingBtn.classList.toggle("sakalux-oco-stage-scanned", !!sessionScanState.Recruiting);
      recruitingBtn.title = sessionScanState.Recruiting
        ? "Recruiting - Scan Complete"
        : "Recruiting - Scan Required";
    }
    if (planningBtn) {
      planningBtn.classList.toggle("sakalux-oco-stage-scanned", !!sessionScanState.Planning);
      planningBtn.title = sessionScanState.Planning
        ? "Planning - Scan Complete"
        : "Planning - Scan Required";
    }
  }
  function renderScanStatus(el) {
    if (!el) return;
    el.classList.remove("is-success", "is-error", "is-scanning");
    el.innerHTML = sessionScanStatusHTML();
    el.title = sessionScanTooltip();
  }
  function flashScanStatus(el, text, type, holdMs = 1600) {
    if (!el) return;
    clearTimeout(el._sakaluxTimer);
    el.classList.remove("is-success", "is-error", "is-scanning");
    if (type === "success") {
      renderScanStatus(el);
      el.classList.add("is-success");
    } else if (type === "error") {
      el.textContent = text;
      el.title = sessionScanTooltip();
      el.classList.add("is-error");
    } else {
      el.textContent = text;
      el.title = sessionScanTooltip();
    }
    el._sakaluxTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      renderScanStatus(el);
    }, holdMs);
  }
  function pulseScanBtn(btn) {
    if (!btn) return;
    btn.classList.remove("sakalux-oco-pulse");
    void btn.offsetWidth;
    btn.classList.add("sakalux-oco-pulse");
  }
  function ensureScanButton() {
    const bar = getTabsBar();
    if (!bar) return;
    if (bar.querySelector(".sakalux-oco-btn-wrap")) {
      const statusEl = bar.querySelector(".sakalux-oco-scan-status");
      if (statusEl && !statusEl.classList.contains("is-success") && !statusEl.classList.contains("is-error") && !statusEl.classList.contains("is-scanning")) {
        renderScanStatus(statusEl);
      }
      updateStageVisuals();
      bindStageAutoRescan();
      return;
    }
    const cs = getComputedStyle(bar);
    if (cs.display !== "flex") {
      bar.style.display = "flex";
      bar.style.alignItems = "center";
    }
    if (!bar.style.gap) bar.style.gap = "6px";
    const wrap = document.createElement("div");
    wrap.className = "sakalux-oco-btn-wrap";
    wrap.innerHTML = `
      <button
        id="sakalux-oco-scan-btn"
        class="sakalux-oco-scan-btn"
        type="button"
        title="Scan this OC stage - scan both Recruiting and Planning for full results."
        aria-label="Scan OC stage"
      >
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">
          <path d="M10.5 4a6.5 6.5 0 1 0 4.06 11.58l3.43 3.43 1.41-1.41-3.43-3.43A6.5 6.5 0 0 0 10.5 4Zm0 2a4.5 4.5 0 1 1 0 9 4.5 4.5 0 0 1 0-9Z"/>
        </svg>
        <span>Scan</span>
      </button>
      <span class="sakalux-oco-scan-status" title="${sessionScanTooltip()}">${sessionScanStatusHTML()}</span>
    `;
    bar.appendChild(wrap);
    const btn = wrap.querySelector(".sakalux-oco-scan-btn");
    const statusEl = wrap.querySelector(".sakalux-oco-scan-status");
    btn.addEventListener("click", async () => {
      btn.disabled = true;
      statusEl.classList.remove("is-success", "is-error");
      statusEl.classList.add("is-scanning");
      statusEl.textContent = "Scanning…";
      statusEl.title = "Scanning current OC stage…";
      try {
        const manualStage =
          getCrimesStageLabel();

        if (
          manualStage === "Recruiting" ||
          manualStage === "Planning"
        ) {
          markStageScanRequired(
            manualStage
          );
          updateStageVisuals();
        }

        let result =
          await scanAvailableCrimesViaApi(
            manualStage,
            true
          );

        if (!result?.ok) {
          result =
            await scanCurrentCrimesStage();
        }

        if (!result.ok) {
          flashScanStatus(
            statusEl,
            result.reason || "Go to Recruiting/Planning",
            "error",
            2200
          );
        } else {
          const visibleStage =

            visibleStage === "Recruiting" ||

      } catch (err) {

        flashScanStatus(statusEl, "Scan failed", "error", 2200);
      } finally {
        btn.disabled = false;
      }
    });
    log("Scan button injected.");
    updateStageVisuals();
    bindStageAutoRescan();
  }
  function startIntelReadyPoll() {
    if (!moduleActive || intelReadyPoll) return;

        (Date.now() - intelReadyPollStartedAt) > 30000

    return [...new Set(selectors.flatMap(sel => Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(sel))))]
      .filter(el => el && isStageButton(el));
  }
  function commonStageBarFromButtons(buttons) {
    const arr = (buttons || []).filter(Boolean);
    if (!arr.length) return null;
    const counts = new Map();
    for (const btn of arr) {
      let el = btn.parentElement;
      for (let i = 0; i < 8 && el && el !== document.body; i++, el = el.parentElement) {
        counts.set(el, (counts.get(el) || 0) + 1);
      }
    }
    let best = null;
    let bestScore = 0;
    for (const [el, count] of counts.entries()) {
      if (count < 2) continue;
      const r = el.getBoundingClientRect?.();
      const score = (count * 1000) - ((r?.height || 0) + (r?.width || 0) / 100);
      if (score > bestScore) {
        best = el;
        bestScore = score;
      }
    }
    return best || arr[0].parentElement || null;
  }
  function getTabsBar() {
    const oldBar = document.querySelector("div.buttonsContainer___aClaa");
    if (oldBar && oldBar.querySelector("button")) return oldBar;
    const buttons = candidateStageButtons();
    return commonStageBarFromButtons(buttons);
  }
  function getStageButtons() {
    const bar = getTabsBar();
    const pool = bar
      ? Array.from(bar.querySelectorAll("button, [role='tab'], [role='button']")).filter(isStageButton)
      : candidateStageButtons();
    let recruitingBtn = null;
    let planningBtn = null;
    let completedBtn = null;
    for (const btn of pool) {
      const t = stageButtonText(btn);
      if (!recruitingBtn && /recruit/.test(t)) recruitingBtn = btn;
      if (!planningBtn && /plan/.test(t)) planningBtn = btn;
      if (!completedBtn && /complet/.test(t)) completedBtn = btn;
    }
    return { recruitingBtn, planningBtn, completedBtn, stageButtons: pool };
  }
  async function handleOcStageEntry(
    stage = getCrimesStageLabel()
  ) {
    if (
      !moduleActive ||
      !isCrimesTab() ||
      (
        stage !== "Recruiting" &&
        stage !== "Planning"
      )
    ) {
      return;
    }

    if (stage === lastObservedOcStage) {
      return;
    }

    // Mark entry immediately so MutationObserver rerenders cannot
    // schedule duplicate API calls while this request is in flight.
    lastObservedOcStage = stage;

    markStageScanRequired(stage);
    updateStageVisuals();

    const statusEl =
      document.querySelector(
        ".sakalux-oco-scan-status"
      );

    if (statusEl) {
      statusEl.classList.remove(
        "is-success",
        "is-error"
      );
      statusEl.classList.add(
        "is-scanning"
      );
      statusEl.textContent =
        `Scanning ${stage} members and roles...`;
      statusEl.title =
        `Scanning every ${stage} OC member, role and required item...`;
    }

    const result =
      await scanAvailableCrimesViaApi(
        stage,
        true
      );

    if (
      result?.ok &&
      result?.stage === stage
    ) {
      markStageScanComplete(stage);
      updateStageVisuals();
      itemTick();
      utilitiesLastSignature = "";

      if (statusEl) {
        flashScanStatus(
          statusEl,
          sessionScanSummary(),
          "success"
        );
      }
      return;
    }

    if (statusEl) {
      flashScanStatus(
        statusEl,
        result?.reason ||
          "API refresh failed",
        "error",
        2200
      );
    }
  }

  function bindStageAutoRescan() {
    const {
      recruitingBtn,
      planningBtn
    } = getStageButtons();

    for (const button of [
      recruitingBtn,
      planningBtn
    ]) {
      if (
        !button ||
        button.dataset
          .sakaluxOcoAutoRescanBound === "1"
      ) {
        continue;
      }

      button.dataset
        .sakaluxOcoAutoRescanBound = "1";

      button.addEventListener(
        "click",
        () => {
          window.setTimeout(() => {
            handleOcStageEntry(
              getCrimesStageLabel()
            ).catch(error => {
              log(
                "OC stage-entry scan failed:",
                error
              );
            });
          }, 120);
        }
      );
    }
  }

  function updateStageVisuals() {
    const { recruitingBtn, planningBtn } = getStageButtons();
    const persistentState =
      readStageScanState();

    sessionScanState.Recruiting =
      !!persistentState.Recruiting.completed;
    sessionScanState.Planning =
      !!persistentState.Planning.completed;

    if (
      sessionScanState.Recruiting &&
      sessionScanState.Planning
    ) {
      utilitiesLastSignature = "";
    }
    if (recruitingBtn) {
      recruitingBtn.classList.toggle("sakalux-oco-stage-scanned", !!sessionScanState.Recruiting);
      recruitingBtn.title = sessionScanState.Recruiting
        ? "Recruiting - Scan Complete"
        : "Recruiting - Scan Required";
    }
    if (planningBtn) {
      planningBtn.classList.toggle("sakalux-oco-stage-scanned", !!sessionScanState.Planning);
      planningBtn.title = sessionScanState.Planning
        ? "Planning - Scan Complete"
        : "Planning - Scan Required";
    }
  }
  function renderScanStatus(el) {
    if (!el) return;
    el.classList.remove("is-success", "is-error", "is-scanning");
    el.innerHTML = sessionScanStatusHTML();
    el.title = sessionScanTooltip();
  }
  function flashScanStatus(el, text, type, holdMs = 1600) {
    if (!el) return;
    clearTimeout(el._sakaluxTimer);
    el.classList.remove("is-success", "is-error", "is-scanning");
    if (type === "success") {
      renderScanStatus(el);
      el.classList.add("is-success");
    } else if (type === "error") {
      el.textContent = text;
      el.title = sessionScanTooltip();
      el.classList.add("is-error");
    } else {
      el.textContent = text;
      el.title = sessionScanTooltip();
    }
    el._sakaluxTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      renderScanStatus(el);
    }, holdMs);
  }
  function pulseScanBtn(btn) {
    if (!btn) return;
    btn.classList.remove("sakalux-oco-pulse");
    void btn.offsetWidth;
    btn.classList.add("sakalux-oco-pulse");
  }
  function ensureScanButton() {
    const bar = getTabsBar();
    if (!bar) return;
    if (bar.querySelector(".sakalux-oco-btn-wrap")) {
      const statusEl = bar.querySelector(".sakalux-oco-scan-status");
      if (statusEl && !statusEl.classList.contains("is-success") && !statusEl.classList.contains("is-error") && !statusEl.classList.contains("is-scanning")) {
        renderScanStatus(statusEl);
      }
      updateStageVisuals();
      bindStageAutoRescan();
      return;
    }
    const cs = getComputedStyle(bar);
    if (cs.display !== "flex") {
      bar.style.display = "flex";

    }
    if (!bar.style.gap) bar.style.gap = "6px";
    const wrap = document.createElement("div");
    wrap.className = "sakalux-oco-btn-wrap";

        id="sakalux-oco-scan-btn"

        aria-label="Scan OC stage"
      >
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">
          <path d="M10.5 4a6.5 6.5 0 1 0 4.06 11.58l3.43 3.43 1.41-1.41-3.43-3.43A6.5 6.5 0 0 0 10.5 4Zm0 2a4.5 4.5 0 1 1 0 9 4.5 4.5 0 0 1 0-9Z"/>
        </svg>
        <span>Scan</span>
      </button>
      <span class="sakalux-oco-scan-status" title="${sessionScanTooltip()}">${sessionScanStatusHTML()}</span>
    `;
    bar.appendChild(wrap);
    const btn = wrap.querySelector(".sakalux-oco-scan-btn");
    const statusEl = wrap.querySelector(".sakalux-oco-scan-status");
    btn.addEventListener("click", async () => {
      btn.disabled = true;
      statusEl.classList.remove("is-success", "is-error");
      statusEl.classList.add("is-scanning");
      statusEl.textContent = "Scanning…";
      statusEl.title = "Scanning current OC stage…";
      try {
        const manualStage =
          getCrimesStageLabel();

        if (
          manualStage === "Recruiting" ||
          manualStage === "Planning"
        ) {
          markStageScanRequired(
            manualStage
          );
          updateStageVisuals();
        }

        let result =
          await scanAvailableCrimesViaApi(
            manualStage,
            true
          );

        if (!result?.ok) {
          result =
            await scanCurrentCrimesStage();
        }

        if (!result.ok) {
          flashScanStatus(
            statusEl,
            result.reason || "Go to Recruiting/Planning",
            "error",
            2200
          );
        } else {
          const visibleStage =
            getCrimesStageLabel();

          if (
            visibleStage === "Recruiting" ||
            visibleStage === "Planning"
          ) {
            markStageScanComplete(
              visibleStage
            );
          }

          updateStageVisuals();
          pulseScanBtn(btn);
          itemTick();
          flashScanStatus(statusEl, sessionScanSummary(), "success");
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("[SakaLuX OC Role Match + Readiness] Scan error:", err);
        flashScanStatus(statusEl, "Scan failed", "error", 2200);
      } finally {
        btn.disabled = false;
      }
    });
    log("Scan button injected.");
    updateStageVisuals();
    bindStageAutoRescan();
  }
  function startIntelReadyPoll() {

        onPageUpdate();

      ) {

    }, 500);
  }

  function startObserver() {
    if (observer) observer.disconnect();
    observer = new MutationObserver(mutations => {
      if (window.SakaLuXPerf?.unrelated?.(mutations)) return;
      const onlyIntelUiChanges = mutations.every(mutation => {
        const target = mutation.target?.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE
          ? mutation.target
          : mutation.target?.parentElement;
        if (!target) return false;
        return (
          target.closest?.("#sakalux-oco-intel-panel") ||
          target.closest?.("#sakalux-oco-intel-tooltip") ||
          mutation.addedNodes && Array.from(mutation.addedNodes).every(node => {
            if (node.nodeType !== Node.ELEMENT_NODE) return true;
            return (
              node.id === "sakalux-oco-intel-tooltip" ||
              node.id === "sakalux-oco-intel-panel" ||
              node.closest?.("#sakalux-oco-intel-panel") ||
              node.closest?.("#sakalux-oco-intel-tooltip")
            );
          })
        );
      });
      if (onlyIntelUiChanges) return;
      clearTimeout(evalTimer);
      evalTimer = setTimeout(onPageUpdate, OBS_DEBOUNCE_MS);
    });
    observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    const signal = eventController?.signal;
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => {
      if (!document.hidden) {
        onPageUpdate();
        startIntelReadyPoll();
      } else {
        closeOcIntelTooltip();
      }
    }, signal ? { signal } : undefined);
    window.addEventListener("pageshow", () => {
      onPageUpdate();
      startIntelReadyPoll();
    }, signal ? { signal } : undefined);
    document.addEventListener("click", e => {
      if (!e.target.closest(".sakalux-oco-has-tooltip")) closeOcIntelTooltip();

      if (isUtilitiesTab() && e.target.closest("a.retrieve")) {
        scheduleUtilitiesMarkerRefresh();
      }
    }, signal ? { capture: true, signal } : true);
    window.addEventListener(
      "scroll",
      closeOcIntelTooltip,
      signal ? { capture: true, passive: true, signal } : true
    );

      "resize",
      closeOcIntelTooltip,

  function updateStageVisuals() {
    const { recruitingBtn, planningBtn } = getStageButtons();
    const persistentState =
      readStageScanState();

    sessionScanState.Recruiting =
      !!persistentState.Recruiting.completed;
    sessionScanState.Planning =
      !!persistentState.Planning.completed;

    if (
      sessionScanState.Recruiting &&
      sessionScanState.Planning
    ) {
      utilitiesLastSignature = "";
    }
    if (recruitingBtn) {
      recruitingBtn.classList.toggle("sakalux-oco-stage-scanned", !!sessionScanState.Recruiting);
      recruitingBtn.title = sessionScanState.Recruiting
        ? "Recruiting - Scan Complete"
        : "Recruiting - Scan Required";
    }
    if (planningBtn) {
      planningBtn.classList.toggle("sakalux-oco-stage-scanned", !!sessionScanState.Planning);
      planningBtn.title = sessionScanState.Planning
        ? "Planning - Scan Complete"
        : "Planning - Scan Required";
    }
  }
  function renderScanStatus(el) {
    if (!el) return;

    el.innerHTML = sessionScanStatusHTML();
    el.title = sessionScanTooltip();
  }
  function flashScanStatus(el, text, type, holdMs = 1600) {
    if (!el) return;
    clearTimeout(el._sakaluxTimer);
    el.classList.remove("is-success", "is-error", "is-scanning");
    if (type === "success") {
      renderScanStatus(el);
      el.classList.add("is-success");
    } else if (type === "error") {
      el.textContent = text;
      el.title = sessionScanTooltip();
      el.classList.add("is-error");
    } else {
      el.textContent = text;
      el.title = sessionScanTooltip();
    }
    el._sakaluxTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      renderScanStatus(el);
    }, holdMs);
  }
  function pulseScanBtn(btn) {

    void btn.offsetWidth;

  }
  function ensureScanButton() {
    const bar = getTabsBar();
    if (!bar) return;
    if (bar.querySelector(".sakalux-oco-btn-wrap")) {
      const statusEl = bar.querySelector(".sakalux-oco-scan-status");
      if (statusEl && !statusEl.classList.contains("is-success") && !statusEl.classList.contains("is-error") && !statusEl.classList.contains("is-scanning")) {
        renderScanStatus(statusEl);
      }
      updateStageVisuals();
      bindStageAutoRescan();
      return;
    }
    const cs = getComputedStyle(bar);
    if (cs.display !== "flex") {
      bar.style.display = "flex";
      bar.style.alignItems = "center";
    }
    if (!bar.style.gap) bar.style.gap = "6px";
    const wrap = document.createElement("div");
    wrap.className = "sakalux-oco-btn-wrap";
    wrap.innerHTML = `
      <button
        id="sakalux-oco-scan-btn"
        class="sakalux-oco-scan-btn"
        type="button"
        title="Scan this OC stage - scan both Recruiting and Planning for full results."
        aria-label="Scan OC stage"
      >
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">
          <path d="M10.5 4a6.5 6.5 0 1 0 4.06 11.58l3.43 3.43 1.41-1.41-3.43-3.43A6.5 6.5 0 0 0 10.5 4Zm0 2a4.5 4.5 0 1 1 0 9 4.5 4.5 0 0 1 0-9Z"/>
        </svg>
        <span>Scan</span>
      </button>
      <span class="sakalux-oco-scan-status" title="${sessionScanTooltip()}">${sessionScanStatusHTML()}</span>
    `;
    bar.appendChild(wrap);
    const btn = wrap.querySelector(".sakalux-oco-scan-btn");
    const statusEl = wrap.querySelector(".sakalux-oco-scan-status");
    btn.addEventListener("click", async () => {
      btn.disabled = true;
      statusEl.classList.remove("is-success", "is-error");
      statusEl.classList.add("is-scanning");
      statusEl.textContent = "Scanning…";
      statusEl.title = "Scanning current OC stage…";
      try {
        const manualStage =
          getCrimesStageLabel();

        if (
          manualStage === "Recruiting" ||
          manualStage === "Planning"
        ) {
          markStageScanRequired(
            manualStage
          );
          updateStageVisuals();
        }

        let result =
          await scanAvailableCrimesViaApi(
            manualStage,
            true
          );

        if (!result?.ok) {
          result =
            await scanCurrentCrimesStage();
        }

        if (!result.ok) {
          flashScanStatus(
            statusEl,
            result.reason || "Go to Recruiting/Planning",
            "error",
            2200
          );
        } else {
          const visibleStage =
            getCrimesStageLabel();

          if (
            visibleStage === "Recruiting" ||
            visibleStage === "Planning"
          ) {
            markStageScanComplete(
              visibleStage
            );
          }

          updateStageVisuals();
          pulseScanBtn(btn);
          itemTick();
          flashScanStatus(statusEl, sessionScanSummary(), "success");
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("[SakaLuX OC Role Match + Readiness] Scan error:", err);
        flashScanStatus(statusEl, "Scan failed", "error", 2200);
      } finally {
        btn.disabled = false;
      }
    });
    log("Scan button injected.");
    updateStageVisuals();
    bindStageAutoRescan();
  }
  function startIntelReadyPoll() {
    if (!moduleActive || intelReadyPoll) return;
    intelReadyPollStartedAt = Date.now();
    intelReadyPoll = setInterval(() => {
      if (!isCrimesTab()) {
        clearInterval(intelReadyPoll);
        intelReadyPoll = null;
        return;
      }
      const cardsReady = getNotInvolvedCards().length > 0;
      if (!onPageUpdate._intelLoadedThisPage && cardsReady) {
        onPageUpdate();
      }
      if (
        onPageUpdate._intelLoadedThisPage ||
        (Date.now() - intelReadyPollStartedAt) > 30000
      ) {
        clearInterval(intelReadyPoll);
        intelReadyPoll = null;
      }
    }, 500);
  }
  function onPageUpdate() {
    if (!moduleActive) return;
    evaluate();
    document.getElementById("sakalux-oco-tab-gear")?.remove();
    const hiddenNativeBox = document.querySelector('div[class*="notInvolvedMembers"][data-sakalux-oco-hidden="1"]');
    if (hiddenNativeBox && !document.getElementById("sakalux-oco-intel-panel")) {
      hiddenNativeBox.style.removeProperty("display");
      delete hiddenNativeBox.dataset.sakaluxOcoHidden;
    }
    if (isCrimesTab()) {
      ensureScanButton();
      refreshNotInOCFromPage();
      updateStageVisuals();
      bindStageAutoRescan();

      const visibleStage =
        getCrimesStageLabel();

      if (
        visibleStage === "Recruiting" ||
        visibleStage === "Planning"
      ) {
        handleOcStageEntry(
          visibleStage
        ).catch(err => {
          log(
            "Automatic OC stage-entry scan failed:",
            err
          );
        });
      }
      const intelCardsReady = getNotInvolvedCards().length > 0;
      if (!onPageUpdate._intelLoadedThisPage && intelCardsReady) {
        onPageUpdate._intelLoadedThisPage = true;
        refreshOcIntelligence(true).catch(err => {
          onPageUpdate._intelLoadedThisPage = false;
          log("OC Intelligence refresh failed:", err);
        });
      } else if (!intelCardsReady) {
        startIntelReadyPoll();
      }
    }
    if (!isCrimesTab()) {
      lastObservedOcStage = "";
    }

    if (isUtilitiesTab()) {
      clearTimeout(onPageUpdate._utilitiesTimer);
      utilitiesLastSignature = "";
      ensureLegend();
      applyUtilitiesFlags();
      onPageUpdate._utilitiesTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        scheduleUtilitiesMarkerRefresh();
      }, 60);
    } else {
      utilitiesLastSignature = "";
    }
  }
  function startObserver() {
    if (observer) observer.disconnect();
    observer = new MutationObserver(mutations => {
      if (window.SakaLuXPerf?.unrelated?.(mutations)) return;
      const onlyIntelUiChanges = mutations.every(mutation => {
        const target = mutation.target?.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE
          ? mutation.target
          : mutation.target?.parentElement;
        if (!target) return false;
        return (
          target.closest?.("#sakalux-oco-intel-panel") ||
          target.closest?.("#sakalux-oco-intel-tooltip") ||
          mutation.addedNodes && Array.from(mutation.addedNodes).every(node => {
            if (node.nodeType !== Node.ELEMENT_NODE) return true;
            return (
              node.id === "sakalux-oco-intel-tooltip" ||
              node.id === "sakalux-oco-intel-panel" ||
              node.closest?.("#sakalux-oco-intel-panel") ||
              node.closest?.("#sakalux-oco-intel-tooltip")
            );
          })
        );
      });
      if (onlyIntelUiChanges) return;
      clearTimeout(evalTimer);
      evalTimer = setTimeout(onPageUpdate, OBS_DEBOUNCE_MS);
    });
    observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    const signal = eventController?.signal;
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => {
      if (!document.hidden) {
        onPageUpdate();
        startIntelReadyPoll();
      } else {
        closeOcIntelTooltip();
      }
    }, signal ? { signal } : undefined);
    window.addEventListener("pageshow", () => {
      onPageUpdate();
      startIntelReadyPoll();
    }, signal ? { signal } : undefined);
    document.addEventListener("click", e => {
      if (!e.target.closest(".sakalux-oco-has-tooltip")) closeOcIntelTooltip();

      if (isUtilitiesTab() && e.target.closest("a.retrieve")) {
        scheduleUtilitiesMarkerRefresh();
      }
    }, signal ? { capture: true, signal } : true);
    window.addEventListener(
      "scroll",
      closeOcIntelTooltip,
      signal ? { capture: true, passive: true, signal } : true
    );
    window.addEventListener(
      "resize",
      closeOcIntelTooltip,
      signal ? { passive: true, signal } : undefined
    );
    if (itemPollInterval) clearInterval(itemPollInterval);
    itemPollInterval = setInterval(itemTick, ITEM_POLL_MS);
    onPageUpdate();
    startIntelReadyPoll();
  }
  function init() {
    if (moduleActive) return;
    moduleActive = true;
    eventController = new AbortController();
    scriptStartedAt = Date.now();
    addStyles();
    if (!document.body) {
      requestAnimationFrame(init);
      return;
    }
    startObserver();
  }
  sessionScanState.Recruiting = false;
  sessionScanState.Planning = false;

      clearInterval(itemPollInterval);

  function startIntelReadyPoll() {

  function onPageUpdate() {
    if (!moduleActive) return;
    evaluate();

      refreshNotInOCFromPage();
      updateStageVisuals();

          );
        });

      if (!onPageUpdate._intelLoadedThisPage && intelCardsReady) {
        onPageUpdate._intelLoadedThisPage = true;
        refreshOcIntelligence(true).catch(err => {
          onPageUpdate._intelLoadedThisPage = false;
          log("OC Intelligence refresh failed:", err);
        });
      } else if (!intelCardsReady) {
        startIntelReadyPoll();
      }
    }
    if (!isCrimesTab()) {
      lastObservedOcStage = "";
    }

    if (isUtilitiesTab()) {
      clearTimeout(onPageUpdate._utilitiesTimer);
      utilitiesLastSignature = "";
      ensureLegend();
      applyUtilitiesFlags();
      onPageUpdate._utilitiesTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        scheduleUtilitiesMarkerRefresh();
      }, 60);
    } else {
      utilitiesLastSignature = "";
    }
  }
  function startObserver() {
    if (observer) observer.disconnect();
    observer = new MutationObserver(mutations => {
      if (window.SakaLuXPerf?.unrelated?.(mutations)) return;
      const onlyIntelUiChanges = mutations.every(mutation => {
        const target = mutation.target?.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE
          ? mutation.target
          : mutation.target?.parentElement;
        if (!target) return false;
        return (
          target.closest?.("#sakalux-oco-intel-panel") ||
          target.closest?.("#sakalux-oco-intel-tooltip") ||
          mutation.addedNodes && Array.from(mutation.addedNodes).every(node => {
            if (node.nodeType !== Node.ELEMENT_NODE) return true;

              node.id === "sakalux-oco-intel-tooltip" ||

            );

      });
      if (onlyIntelUiChanges) return;
      clearTimeout(evalTimer);
      evalTimer = setTimeout(onPageUpdate, OBS_DEBOUNCE_MS);
    });
    observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });

        scheduleUtilitiesMarkerRefresh();

      closeOcIntelTooltip,

    window.addEventListener(
      "resize",
      closeOcIntelTooltip,
      signal ? { passive: true, signal } : undefined
    );
    if (itemPollInterval) clearInterval(itemPollInterval);
    itemPollInterval = setInterval(itemTick, ITEM_POLL_MS);
    onPageUpdate();
    startIntelReadyPoll();
  }

      } else if (!intelCardsReady) {
        startIntelReadyPoll();
      }
    }
    if (!isCrimesTab()) {
      lastObservedOcStage = "";
    }

    if (isUtilitiesTab()) {
      clearTimeout(onPageUpdate._utilitiesTimer);
      utilitiesLastSignature = "";
      ensureLegend();
      applyUtilitiesFlags();
      onPageUpdate._utilitiesTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        scheduleUtilitiesMarkerRefresh();
      }, 60);
    } else {
      utilitiesLastSignature = "";
    }
  }
  function startObserver() {
    if (observer) observer.disconnect();
    observer = new MutationObserver(mutations => {
      if (window.SakaLuXPerf?.unrelated?.(mutations)) return;
      const onlyIntelUiChanges = mutations.every(mutation => {
        const target = mutation.target?.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE
          ? mutation.target
          : mutation.target?.parentElement;
        if (!target) return false;
        return (
          target.closest?.("#sakalux-oco-intel-panel") ||
          target.closest?.("#sakalux-oco-intel-tooltip") ||
          mutation.addedNodes && Array.from(mutation.addedNodes).every(node => {
            if (node.nodeType !== Node.ELEMENT_NODE) return true;
            return (
              node.id === "sakalux-oco-intel-tooltip" ||
              node.id === "sakalux-oco-intel-panel" ||
              node.closest?.("#sakalux-oco-intel-panel") ||
              node.closest?.("#sakalux-oco-intel-tooltip")
            );
          })
        );
      });
      if (onlyIntelUiChanges) return;
      clearTimeout(evalTimer);
      evalTimer = setTimeout(onPageUpdate, OBS_DEBOUNCE_MS);
    });
    observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    const signal = eventController?.signal;
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => {
      if (!document.hidden) {
        onPageUpdate();
        startIntelReadyPoll();
      } else {
        closeOcIntelTooltip();
      }
    }, signal ? { signal } : undefined);
    window.addEventListener("pageshow", () => {
      onPageUpdate();
      startIntelReadyPoll();
    }, signal ? { signal } : undefined);
    document.addEventListener("click", e => {
      if (!e.target.closest(".sakalux-oco-has-tooltip")) closeOcIntelTooltip();

      if (isUtilitiesTab() && e.target.closest("a.retrieve")) {
        scheduleUtilitiesMarkerRefresh();
      }
    }, signal ? { capture: true, signal } : true);
    window.addEventListener(
      "scroll",
      closeOcIntelTooltip,
      signal ? { capture: true, passive: true, signal } : true
    );
    window.addEventListener(
      "resize",
      closeOcIntelTooltip,
      signal ? { passive: true, signal } : undefined
    );
    if (itemPollInterval) clearInterval(itemPollInterval);
    itemPollInterval = setInterval(itemTick, ITEM_POLL_MS);
    onPageUpdate();
    startIntelReadyPoll();
  }
  function init() {
    if (moduleActive) return;
    moduleActive = true;
    eventController = new AbortController();
    scriptStartedAt = Date.now();
    addStyles();
    if (!document.body) {
      requestAnimationFrame(init);
      return;
    }
    startObserver();
  }
  sessionScanState.Recruiting = false;
  sessionScanState.Planning = false;
  function destroy() {
    moduleActive = false;
    eventController?.abort();
    eventController = null;
    observer?.disconnect();
    observer = null;
    clearTimeout(evalTimer);
    clearTimeout(onPageUpdate._utilitiesTimer);
    if (hudInterval) {
      clearInterval(hudInterval);
      hudInterval = null;
    }
    if (itemPollInterval) {
      clearInterval(itemPollInterval);
      itemPollInterval = null;
    }
    apiOcStagePromises.Recruiting = null;
    apiOcStagePromises.Planning = null;
    apiOcStageLastAt.Recruiting = 0;
    apiOcStageLastAt.Planning = 0;
    lastObservedOcStage = "";
    if (intelReadyPoll) {
      clearInterval(intelReadyPoll);
      intelReadyPoll = null;
    }
    removePopup();
    removeItemAlert();
    removeSettings();
    removeHud();
    closeOcIntelTooltip();
    document.getElementById(STYLE_ID)?.remove();
    document.getElementById("sakalux-oco-tab-gear")?.remove();
    document.querySelectorAll(".sakalux-oco-btn-wrap").forEach(el => el.remove());
    document.getElementById("sakalux-oco-intel-panel")?.remove();
    document.querySelectorAll(
      'div[class*="notInvolvedMembers"][data-sakalux-oco-hidden="1"]'
    ).forEach(box => {
      box.style.removeProperty("display");
      delete box.dataset.sakaluxOcoHidden;
    });
    clearLoanedFlags();
    document.querySelectorAll(".sakalux-oco-stage-scanned").forEach(el => {
      el.classList.remove("sakalux-oco-stage-scanned");
      el.removeAttribute("title");
    });
  }
  return {
    init,
    destroy,
    openSettings: showSettings,
    onRouteChange: onPageUpdate
  };
  }

  function onPageUpdate() {
    if (!moduleActive) return;
    evaluate();
    document.getElementById("sakalux-oco-tab-gear")?.remove();
    const hiddenNativeBox = document.querySelector('div[class*="notInvolvedMembers"][data-sakalux-oco-hidden="1"]');
    if (hiddenNativeBox && !document.getElementById("sakalux-oco-intel-panel")) {
      hiddenNativeBox.style.removeProperty("display");
      delete hiddenNativeBox.dataset.sakaluxOcoHidden;
    }
    if (isCrimesTab()) {
      ensureScanButton();
      refreshNotInOCFromPage();
      updateStageVisuals();
      bindStageAutoRescan();

      const visibleStage =
        getCrimesStageLabel();

      if (
        visibleStage === "Recruiting" ||
        visibleStage === "Planning"
      ) {
        handleOcStageEntry(
          visibleStage
        ).catch(err => {
          log(
            "Automatic OC stage-entry scan failed:",
            err
          );
        });
      }
      const intelCardsReady = getNotInvolvedCards().length > 0;
      if (!onPageUpdate._intelLoadedThisPage && intelCardsReady) {
        onPageUpdate._intelLoadedThisPage = true;
        refreshOcIntelligence(true).catch(err => {
          onPageUpdate._intelLoadedThisPage = false;
          log("OC Intelligence refresh failed:", err);
        });
      } else if (!intelCardsReady) {
        startIntelReadyPoll();
      }
    }
    if (!isCrimesTab()) {
      lastObservedOcStage = "";
    }

    if (isUtilitiesTab()) {

      utilitiesLastSignature = "";
      ensureLegend();
      applyUtilitiesFlags();

        scheduleUtilitiesMarkerRefresh();

    } else {
      utilitiesLastSignature = "";
    }
  }
