      if (
        visibleStage === "Recruiting" ||
        visibleStage === "Planning"
      ) {
        handleOcStageEntry(
          visibleStage
        ).catch(err => {
          log(
            "Automatic OC stage-entry scan failed:",
            err
          );
        });
      }
      const intelCardsReady = getNotInvolvedCards().length > 0;
      if (!onPageUpdate._intelLoadedThisPage && intelCardsReady) {
        onPageUpdate._intelLoadedThisPage = true;
        refreshOcIntelligence(true).catch(err => {
          onPageUpdate._intelLoadedThisPage = false;
          log("OC Intelligence refresh failed:", err);
        });
      } else if (!intelCardsReady) {
        startIntelReadyPoll();
      }
    }
    if (!isCrimesTab()) {
      lastObservedOcStage = "";
    }

    if (isUtilitiesTab()) {
      clearTimeout(onPageUpdate._utilitiesTimer);
      utilitiesLastSignature = "";
      ensureLegend();
      applyUtilitiesFlags();
      onPageUpdate._utilitiesTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        scheduleUtilitiesMarkerRefresh();
      }, 60);
    } else {
      utilitiesLastSignature = "";
    }
  }
  function startObserver() {
    if (observer) observer.disconnect();
    observer = new MutationObserver(mutations => {
      if (window.SakaLuXPerf?.unrelated?.(mutations)) return;
      const onlyIntelUiChanges = mutations.every(mutation => {
        const target = mutation.target?.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE
          ? mutation.target
          : mutation.target?.parentElement;
        if (!target) return false;
        return (
          target.closest?.("#sakalux-oco-intel-panel") ||
          target.closest?.("#sakalux-oco-intel-tooltip") ||
          mutation.addedNodes && Array.from(mutation.addedNodes).every(node => {
            if (node.nodeType !== Node.ELEMENT_NODE) return true;
            return (
              node.id === "sakalux-oco-intel-tooltip" ||
              node.id === "sakalux-oco-intel-panel" ||
              node.closest?.("#sakalux-oco-intel-panel") ||
              node.closest?.("#sakalux-oco-intel-tooltip")
            );
          })
        );
      });
      if (onlyIntelUiChanges) return;
      clearTimeout(evalTimer);
      evalTimer = setTimeout(onPageUpdate, OBS_DEBOUNCE_MS);
    });
    observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    const signal = eventController?.signal;
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => {
      if (!document.hidden) {
        onPageUpdate();
        startIntelReadyPoll();
      } else {
        closeOcIntelTooltip();
      }
    }, signal ? { signal } : undefined);
    window.addEventListener("pageshow", () => {
      onPageUpdate();
      startIntelReadyPoll();
    }, signal ? { signal } : undefined);
    document.addEventListener("click", e => {
      if (!e.target.closest(".sakalux-oco-has-tooltip")) closeOcIntelTooltip();

      if (isUtilitiesTab() && e.target.closest("a.retrieve")) {
        scheduleUtilitiesMarkerRefresh();
      }
    }, signal ? { capture: true, signal } : true);
    window.addEventListener(
      "scroll",
      closeOcIntelTooltip,
      signal ? { capture: true, passive: true, signal } : true
    );
    window.addEventListener(
      "resize",
      closeOcIntelTooltip,
      signal ? { passive: true, signal } : undefined
    );
    if (itemPollInterval) clearInterval(itemPollInterval);
    itemPollInterval = setInterval(itemTick, ITEM_POLL_MS);
    onPageUpdate();
    startIntelReadyPoll();
  }
  function init() {
    if (moduleActive) return;
    moduleActive = true;
    eventController = new AbortController();
    scriptStartedAt = Date.now();
    addStyles();
    if (!document.body) {
      requestAnimationFrame(init);
      return;
    }
    startObserver();
  }
  sessionScanState.Recruiting = false;
  sessionScanState.Planning = false;
  function destroy() {
    moduleActive = false;
    eventController?.abort();
    eventController = null;
    observer?.disconnect();
    observer = null;
    clearTimeout(evalTimer);
    clearTimeout(onPageUpdate._utilitiesTimer);
    if (hudInterval) {
      clearInterval(hudInterval);
      hudInterval = null;
    }
    if (itemPollInterval) {
      clearInterval(itemPollInterval);
      itemPollInterval = null;
    }
    apiOcStagePromises.Recruiting = null;
    apiOcStagePromises.Planning = null;
    apiOcStageLastAt.Recruiting = 0;
    apiOcStageLastAt.Planning = 0;
    lastObservedOcStage = "";
    if (intelReadyPoll) {
      clearInterval(intelReadyPoll);
      intelReadyPoll = null;
    }
    removePopup();
    removeItemAlert();
    removeSettings();
    removeHud();
    closeOcIntelTooltip();
    document.getElementById(STYLE_ID)?.remove();
    document.getElementById("sakalux-oco-tab-gear")?.remove();
    document.querySelectorAll(".sakalux-oco-btn-wrap").forEach(el => el.remove());
    document.getElementById("sakalux-oco-intel-panel")?.remove();
    document.querySelectorAll(
      'div[class*="notInvolvedMembers"][data-sakalux-oco-hidden="1"]'
    ).forEach(box => {
      box.style.removeProperty("display");
      delete box.dataset.sakaluxOcoHidden;
    });
    clearLoanedFlags();
    document.querySelectorAll(".sakalux-oco-stage-scanned").forEach(el => {
      el.classList.remove("sakalux-oco-stage-scanned");
      el.removeAttribute("title");
    });
  }
  return {
    init,
    destroy,
    openSettings: showSettings,
    onRouteChange: onPageUpdate
  };
  }

  function readStageScanState() {
    const saved = store.get(
      STAGE_SCAN_STATE_KEY,
      {}
    );

    return {
      Recruiting: {
        completed:
          !!saved?.Recruiting?.completed,
        scannedAt:
          Number(
            saved?.Recruiting?.scannedAt || 0
          )
      },
      Planning: {
        completed:
          !!saved?.Planning?.completed,
        scannedAt:
          Number(
            saved?.Planning?.scannedAt || 0
          )
      }
    };
  }

  function writeStageScanState(stateValue) {
    store.set(
      STAGE_SCAN_STATE_KEY,
      stateValue
    );
  }

  const sessionScanState = {
    Recruiting: false,
    Planning: false
  };

  function markStageScanRequired(stage) {
    if (
      stage !== "Recruiting" &&
      stage !== "Planning"
    ) {
      return;
    }

    sessionScanState[stage] = false;

    const state =
      readStageScanState();

    state[stage] = {
      ...state[stage],
      completed: false
    };

    writeStageScanState(state);
  }

  function markStageScanComplete(stage) {
    if (
      stage !== "Recruiting" &&
      stage !== "Planning"
    ) {
      return;
    }

    sessionScanState[stage] = true;

    const state =
      readStageScanState();

    state[stage] = {
      completed: true,
      scannedAt: now()
    };

    writeStageScanState(state);
  }

  function isAllowedItemId(id) {

  function itemUsageLines(itemId) {
    const uses = OC_ITEM_USAGE[String(itemId)] || [];
    if (!uses.length) return [];
    const seen = new Set();
    return uses
      .map(u => {
        const note = u.note ? ` (${u.note})` : "";
        return `${u.oc} - ${u.role}${note}`;
      })
      .filter(line => {
        if (seen.has(line)) return false;
        seen.add(line);
        return true;
      });
  }
  function buildItemUsageTitle(itemId, lead) {
    const itemName = OC_ITEM_NAMES[String(itemId)] || `Item #${itemId}`;
    const lines = itemUsageLines(itemId);
    const parts = [];
    if (lead) parts.push(lead);
    if (lines.length) {
      parts.push(`${itemName} is used in:\n${lines.map(line => `• ${line}`).join("\n")}`);
    } else {
      parts.push(`${itemName} is included as an OC utility item, but no OC role usage has been mapped yet.`);
    }
    return parts.join("\n\n");
  }

  function hasOcIcon() {
    const directSelectors = [
      'a[aria-label*="Organized Crime" i]',
      'a[aria-label*="Organised Crime" i]',
      'button[aria-label*="Organized Crime" i]',
      'button[aria-label*="Organised Crime" i]',
      '[title*="Organized Crime" i]',
      '[title*="Organised Crime" i]',
      'a[href*="organizedcrimes.php"]',
      'a[href*="organizedCrime"]',
      'a[href*="organized-crime"]'
    ];
    if (directSelectors.some(sel => document.querySelector(sel))) return true;
    const iconAreas = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(
      'div[class^="status-icons"], div[class*="statusIcons"], li[class^="icon"], [class*="status-icon"], [class*="statusIcon"]'
    ));
    return iconAreas.some(area => {

        area.getAttribute("title"),

    });

  const STAGE_SCAN_STATE_KEY = "sakalux_oco_stage_scan_state_v1";

  function readStageScanState() {
    const saved = store.get(
      STAGE_SCAN_STATE_KEY,
      {}
    );

    return {
      Recruiting: {
        completed:
          !!saved?.Recruiting?.completed,
        scannedAt:
          Number(
            saved?.Recruiting?.scannedAt || 0
          )
      },
      Planning: {
        completed:
          !!saved?.Planning?.completed,
        scannedAt:
          Number(
            saved?.Planning?.scannedAt || 0
          )
      }
    };
  }

  function writeStageScanState(stateValue) {
    store.set(
      STAGE_SCAN_STATE_KEY,
      stateValue
    );
  }

  const sessionScanState = {
    Recruiting: false,
    Planning: false
  };

  function markStageScanRequired(stage) {
    if (
      stage !== "Recruiting" &&
      stage !== "Planning"
    ) {
      return;
    }

    sessionScanState[stage] = false;

    const state =
      readStageScanState();

    state[stage] = {
      ...state[stage],
      completed: false
    };

    writeStageScanState(state);
  }

  function markStageScanComplete(stage) {
    if (
      stage !== "Recruiting" &&
      stage !== "Planning"
    ) {
      return;
    }

    sessionScanState[stage] = true;

    const state =
      readStageScanState();

    state[stage] = {
      completed: true,
      scannedAt: now()
    };

    writeStageScanState(state);
  }

  function loadLS(key) {

  }
  function saveLS(key, value) {

  function isAllowedItemId(id) {
    const s = String(id ?? "");
    return s && !EXCLUDED_ITEM_IDS.has(s) && INCLUDED_ITEM_IDS.has(s);
  }
  function itemUsageLines(itemId) {
    const uses = OC_ITEM_USAGE[String(itemId)] || [];
    if (!uses.length) return [];
    const seen = new Set();
    return uses
      .map(u => {
        const note = u.note ? ` (${u.note})` : "";
        return `${u.oc} - ${u.role}${note}`;
      })
      .filter(line => {
        if (seen.has(line)) return false;
        seen.add(line);
        return true;
      });
  }
  function buildItemUsageTitle(itemId, lead) {
    const itemName = OC_ITEM_NAMES[String(itemId)] || `Item #${itemId}`;
    const lines = itemUsageLines(itemId);
    const parts = [];
    if (lead) parts.push(lead);
    if (lines.length) {
      parts.push(`${itemName} is used in:\n${lines.map(line => `• ${line}`).join("\n")}`);
    } else {
      parts.push(`${itemName} is included as an OC utility item, but no OC role usage has been mapped yet.`);
    }
    return parts.join("\n\n");
  }

  }
  function rectCenter(el) {
    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();

  }
  function dist(a, b) {
    return Math.sqrt((a.x - b.x) ** 2 + (a.y - b.y) ** 2);
  }

  function hasOcIcon() {
    const directSelectors = [

      'button[aria-label*="Organized Crime" i]',

    });
  }

  function readStageScanState() {
    const saved = store.get(
      STAGE_SCAN_STATE_KEY,
      {}
    );

    return {
      Recruiting: {
        completed:
          !!saved?.Recruiting?.completed,
        scannedAt:
          Number(
            saved?.Recruiting?.scannedAt || 0
          )
      },
      Planning: {
        completed:
          !!saved?.Planning?.completed,
        scannedAt:
          Number(
            saved?.Planning?.scannedAt || 0
          )
      }
    };
  }

  function writeStageScanState(stateValue) {
    store.set(
      STAGE_SCAN_STATE_KEY,
      stateValue
    );
  }

  const sessionScanState = {
    Recruiting: false,
    Planning: false
  };

  function markStageScanRequired(stage) {
    if (
      stage !== "Recruiting" &&
      stage !== "Planning"
    ) {
      return;
    }

    sessionScanState[stage] = false;

    const state =
      readStageScanState();

    state[stage] = {
      ...state[stage],
      completed: false
    };

    writeStageScanState(state);
  }

  function markStageScanComplete(stage) {
    if (
      stage !== "Recruiting" &&
      stage !== "Planning"
    ) {
      return;
    }

    sessionScanState[stage] = true;

    const state =
      readStageScanState();

    state[stage] = {
      completed: true,
      scannedAt: now()
    };

    writeStageScanState(state);
  }

  function itemUsageLines(itemId) {
    const uses = OC_ITEM_USAGE[String(itemId)] || [];
    if (!uses.length) return [];
    const seen = new Set();
    return uses
      .map(u => {
        const note = u.note ? ` (${u.note})` : "";
        return `${u.oc} - ${u.role}${note}`;
      })
      .filter(line => {
        if (seen.has(line)) return false;
        seen.add(line);
        return true;
      });
  }
  function buildItemUsageTitle(itemId, lead) {
    const itemName = OC_ITEM_NAMES[String(itemId)] || `Item #${itemId}`;
    const lines = itemUsageLines(itemId);
    const parts = [];
    if (lead) parts.push(lead);
    if (lines.length) {
      parts.push(`${itemName} is used in:\n${lines.map(line => `• ${line}`).join("\n")}`);
    } else {
      parts.push(`${itemName} is included as an OC utility item, but no OC role usage has been mapped yet.`);
    }
    return parts.join("\n\n");
  }

  function itemUsageLines(itemId) {
    const uses = OC_ITEM_USAGE[String(itemId)] || [];
    if (!uses.length) return [];
    const seen = new Set();
    return uses
      .map(u => {
        const note = u.note ? ` (${u.note})` : "";
        return `${u.oc} - ${u.role}${note}`;
      })
      .filter(line => {
        if (seen.has(line)) return false;
        seen.add(line);

      });
  }
  function buildItemUsageTitle(itemId, lead) {
    const itemName = OC_ITEM_NAMES[String(itemId)] || `Item #${itemId}`;
    const lines = itemUsageLines(itemId);
    const parts = [];
    if (lead) parts.push(lead);
    if (lines.length) {
      parts.push(`${itemName} is used in:\n${lines.map(line => `• ${line}`).join("\n")}`);
    } else {
      parts.push(`${itemName} is included as an OC utility item, but no OC role usage has been mapped yet.`);
    }
    return parts.join("\n\n");
  }

  const STAGE_SCAN_STATE_KEY = "sakalux_oco_stage_scan_state_v1";

  function readStageScanState() {
    const saved = store.get(
      STAGE_SCAN_STATE_KEY,
      {}
    );

    return {
      Recruiting: {
        completed:
          !!saved?.Recruiting?.completed,
        scannedAt:
          Number(
            saved?.Recruiting?.scannedAt || 0
          )
      },
      Planning: {
        completed:
          !!saved?.Planning?.completed,
        scannedAt:
          Number(
            saved?.Planning?.scannedAt || 0
          )
      }
    };
  }

  function writeStageScanState(stateValue) {
    store.set(
      STAGE_SCAN_STATE_KEY,
      stateValue
    );
  }

  const sessionScanState = {
    Recruiting: false,
    Planning: false
  };

  function markStageScanRequired(stage) {
    if (
      stage !== "Recruiting" &&
      stage !== "Planning"
    ) {
      return;
    }

    sessionScanState[stage] = false;

    const state =
      readStageScanState();

    state[stage] = {
      ...state[stage],
      completed: false
    };

    writeStageScanState(state);
  }

  function markStageScanComplete(stage) {
    if (
      stage !== "Recruiting" &&
      stage !== "Planning"
    ) {
      return;
    }

    sessionScanState[stage] = true;

    const state =
      readStageScanState();

    state[stage] = {
      completed: true,
      scannedAt: now()
    };

    writeStageScanState(state);
  }

  function loadLS(key) {
    try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key) || "null"); }
    catch { return null; }
  }
  function saveLS(key, value) {
    localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(value));

  function isAllowedItemId(id) {
    const s = String(id ?? "");
    return s && !EXCLUDED_ITEM_IDS.has(s) && INCLUDED_ITEM_IDS.has(s);
  }
  function itemUsageLines(itemId) {
    const uses = OC_ITEM_USAGE[String(itemId)] || [];
    if (!uses.length) return [];
    const seen = new Set();
    return uses
      .map(u => {
        const note = u.note ? ` (${u.note})` : "";
        return `${u.oc} - ${u.role}${note}`;
      })
      .filter(line => {
        if (seen.has(line)) return false;
        seen.add(line);
        return true;
      });
  }
  function buildItemUsageTitle(itemId, lead) {
    const itemName = OC_ITEM_NAMES[String(itemId)] || `Item #${itemId}`;
    const lines = itemUsageLines(itemId);
    const parts = [];
    if (lead) parts.push(lead);
    if (lines.length) {
      parts.push(`${itemName} is used in:\n${lines.map(line => `• ${line}`).join("\n")}`);
    } else {
      parts.push(`${itemName} is included as an OC utility item, but no OC role usage has been mapped yet.`);
    }
    return parts.join("\n\n");
  }
  function xidFromHref(href) {

    return m ? m[1] : null;
  }
  function itemIdFromSrc(src) {
    const m = String(src ?? "").match(/\/images\/items\/(\d+)\//i);
    return m ? m[1] : null;
  }

  function hasOcIcon() {
    const directSelectors = [
      'a[aria-label*="Organized Crime" i]',
      'a[aria-label*="Organised Crime" i]',
      'button[aria-label*="Organized Crime" i]',
      'button[aria-label*="Organised Crime" i]',
      '[title*="Organized Crime" i]',
      '[title*="Organised Crime" i]',
      'a[href*="organizedcrimes.php"]',
      'a[href*="organizedCrime"]',
      'a[href*="organized-crime"]'
    ];
    if (directSelectors.some(sel => document.querySelector(sel))) return true;
    const iconAreas = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(
      'div[class^="status-icons"], div[class*="statusIcons"], li[class^="icon"], [class*="status-icon"], [class*="statusIcon"]'
    ));
    return iconAreas.some(area => {
      const text = [
        area.getAttribute("aria-label"),
        area.getAttribute("title"),
        area.textContent
      ].filter(Boolean).join(" ");
      return /organi[sz]ed\s+crime|oc\s*(ready|active|complete|planning|recruiting)/i.test(text);
    });
  }

function readOutsideState() {
    const raw = loadLS(OC_OUTSIDE_KEY);
    return raw && typeof raw === "object" ? raw : {};
  }
  function saveOutsideState(state) { saveLS(OC_OUTSIDE_KEY, state || {}); }
  function normalizeUnix(value) {
    const n = Number(value);
    if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n <= 0) return 0;
    return n > 1e12 ? Math.floor(n / 1000) : Math.floor(n);
  }
  function crimeTier(crime) {
    const values = [crime?.difficulty, crime?.tier, crime?.level, crime?.crime?.difficulty, crime?.crime?.tier, crime?.scenario?.difficulty, crime?.scenario?.tier];
    for (const value of values) {
      const n = Number(value);
      if (Number.isFinite(n) && n >= 1 && n <= 10) return Math.round(n);
    }
    const text = [crime?.name, crime?.crime?.name, crime?.scenario?.name, crime?.title].filter(Boolean).join(" ");
    const match = text.match(/\b(?:tier|level|difficulty)\s*([1-9]|10)\b/i);
    return match ? Number(match[1]) : 0;
  }
  function crimeCompletedAt(crime) {
    const values = [crime?.executed_at, crime?.completed_at, crime?.finished_at, crime?.ended_at, crime?.resolution?.completed_at, crime?.timestamps?.completed, crime?.timestamps?.executed, crime?.ready_at].map(normalizeUnix).filter(Boolean);
    return values.length ? Math.max(...values) : 0;
  }
  function crimeStatus(crime) {
    return String(crime?.status || crime?.state || crime?.result?.status || crime?.resolution?.status || "").toLowerCase();
  }
  function crimeMemberIds(crime) {
    const output = new Set();
    const collections = [crime?.slots, crime?.participants, crime?.members, crime?.users, crime?.crew, crime?.crime?.slots];
    const collect = value => {
      if (!value) return;
      if (Array.isArray(value)) { value.forEach(collect); return; }
      if (typeof value !== "object") return;
      const direct = value.user_id ?? value.userId ?? value.member_id ?? value.memberId ?? value.xid ?? value.id;
      if (direct && /^\d+$/.test(String(direct))) output.add(String(direct));
      if (value.user) collect(value.user);
      if (value.member) collect(value.member);
      for (const [key, child] of Object.entries(value)) {
        if (/^\d+$/.test(key) && child && typeof child === "object") output.add(String(key));
        if (child && typeof child === "object" && !["user", "member"].includes(key)) collect(child);
      }
    };
    collections.forEach(collect);
    return [...output];
  }
  function unwrapCrimeList(payload) {
    const candidates = [payload?.crimes, payload?.organized_crimes, payload?.organizedCrimes, payload?.data?.crimes, payload?.data?.organized_crimes, payload?.data];
    for (const value of candidates) {
      if (Array.isArray(value)) return value;
      if (value && typeof value === "object") {
        const arr = Object.values(value).filter(v => v && typeof v === "object");
        if (arr.length) return arr;
      }
    }
    return [];
  }
  async function tornApiFetch(path, apiKey) {
    const response = await fetch(`https://api.torn.com/v2${path}`, {
      method: "GET",
      headers: { "Authorization": `ApiKey ${apiKey}`, "Accept": "application/json" },
      credentials: "omit",
      cache: "no-store"
    });
    let data;
    try { data = await response.json(); }
    catch { throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}`); }
    const apiError = data?.error || data?.errors?.[0];
    if (!response.ok || apiError) throw new Error(String(apiError?.error || apiError?.message || data?.message || `HTTP ${response.status}`));
    return data;
  }
  async function fetchFactionCrimes(apiKey, force = false, pageCount = 4) {
    if (!apiKey) throw new Error("API key not configured");
    const cached = loadLS(OC_API_CACHE_KEY);
    if (!force && cached?.ts && (now() - cached.ts) < OC_API_CACHE_MS && Array.isArray(cached.crimes)) {
      return cached.crimes;
    }
    const all = [];
    let offset = 0;
    const cutoff = Math.floor(now() / 1000) - OC_HISTORY_WINDOW_SECONDS;
    for (let page = 0; page < pageCount; page++) {
      const query = new URLSearchParams({
        cat: "completed",
        limit: String(OC_API_PAGE_LIMIT),
        offset: String(offset),
        sort: "DESC"
      });
      const payload = await tornApiFetch(`/faction/crimes?${query}`, apiKey);
      const crimes = unwrapCrimeList(payload);
      all.push(...crimes.filter(crime => {
        const completedAt = crimeCompletedAt(crime);
        return !completedAt || completedAt >= cutoff;
      }));
      const oldestCompleted = crimes
        .map(crimeCompletedAt)
        .filter(Boolean)
        .sort((a, b) => a - b)[0] || 0;
      if (crimes.length < OC_API_PAGE_LIMIT || (oldestCompleted && oldestCompleted < cutoff)) break;
      offset += OC_API_PAGE_LIMIT;
    }
    saveLS(OC_API_CACHE_KEY, { ts: now(), crimes: all, cutoff });
    return all;
  }

  async function scanAvailableCrimesViaApi(
    targetStage = getCrimesStageLabel(),
    force = false
  ) {
    if (
      targetStage !== "Recruiting" &&
      targetStage !== "Planning"
    ) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        stage: targetStage,
        reason: "Not on Recruiting/Planning"
      };
    }

    const apiKey = getSharedApiKey();
    if (!apiKey) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        stage: targetStage,
        reason: "API key not configured"
      };
    }

    if (
      !force &&
      apiOcStageLastAt[targetStage] &&
      (now() - apiOcStageLastAt[targetStage]) <
        API_OC_AUTO_SCAN_MS
    ) {
      return {
        ok: true,
        cached: true,
        stage: targetStage
      };
    }

    if (apiOcStagePromises[targetStage]) {
      return apiOcStagePromises[targetStage];
    }

    apiOcStagePromises[targetStage] = (async () => {
      const query = new URLSearchParams({
        cat: "available",
        limit: "100",
        sort: "ASC"
      });

      const payload =
        await tornApiFetch(
          `/faction/crimes?${query}`,
          apiKey
        );

      const crimes = unwrapCrimeList(payload);
      const byStage = {
        Recruiting: {
          usersInOC: new Set(),
          reqByUser: {},
          missingByUser: {},
          roleByUser: {},
          crimeByUser: {}
        },
        Planning: {
          usersInOC: new Set(),
          reqByUser: {},
          missingByUser: {},
          roleByUser: {},
          crimeByUser: {}
        }
      };

      for (const crime of crimes) {
        const stage = apiCrimeStage(crime);
        if (!stage || !byStage[stage]) continue;

        for (const slot of apiCrimeSlots(crime)) {
          const xid = apiSlotUserId(slot);
          if (!xid) continue;

          const stageData = byStage[stage];
          stageData.usersInOC.add(xid);

          const roleName =
            apiSlotRoleName(slot);
          const crimeName =
            apiCrimeName(crime);

          if (roleName) {
            stageData.roleByUser[xid] =
              roleName;
          }
          if (crimeName) {
            stageData.crimeByUser[xid] =
              crimeName;
          }

          const requirement =
            apiSlotRequirement(slot);

          if (!requirement) continue;

          if (!stageData.reqByUser[xid]) {
            stageData.reqByUser[xid] = [];
          }
          if (
            !stageData.reqByUser[xid].includes(
              requirement.id
            )
          ) {
            stageData.reqByUser[xid].push(
              requirement.id
            );
          }

          if (requirement.isAvailable === false) {
            if (!stageData.missingByUser[xid]) {
              stageData.missingByUser[xid] = [];
            }
            if (
              !stageData.missingByUser[xid].includes(
                requirement.id
              )
            ) {
              stageData.missingByUser[xid].push(
                requirement.id
              );
            }
          }
        }
      }

      const data =
        byStage[targetStage];

      writeScan({
        stage: targetStage,
        ts: now(),
        source: "api",
        usersInOC: [...data.usersInOC],
        reqByUser: data.reqByUser,
        missingByUser: data.missingByUser,
        roleByUser: data.roleByUser,
        crimeByUser: data.crimeByUser
      });

      apiOcStageLastAt[targetStage] = now();

      log("API OC scan saved:", {
        crimes: crimes.length,
        targetStage,
        recruiting: byStage.Recruiting.usersInOC.size,
        planning: byStage.Planning.usersInOC.size
      });

      return {
        ok: true,
        source: "api",
        stage: targetStage,
        crimes: crimes.length
      };
    })()
      .catch(error => {
        log("API OC auto scan failed:", error);
        return {
          ok: false,
          reason: error?.message || "API scan failed"
        };
      })
      .finally(() => {
        apiOcStagePromises[targetStage] =
          null;
      });

    return apiOcStagePromises[targetStage];
  }

  function calculateMemberIntelligence(crimes) {
    const memberTiers = {};
    const lastCompleted = {};
    const joinedCounts = {};
    const passedCounts = {};
    const cutoff = Math.floor(now() / 1000) - OC_HISTORY_WINDOW_SECONDS;
    for (const crime of crimes || []) {
      const completedAt = crimeCompletedAt(crime);
      if (completedAt && completedAt < cutoff) continue;
      const tier = crimeTier(crime);
      const status = crimeStatus(crime);
      const passed = !status || /(success|successful|completed|complete|executed|passed)/i.test(status);
      const members = crimeMemberIds(crime);
      for (const xid of members) {
        joinedCounts[xid] = (joinedCounts[xid] || 0) + 1;
        if (passed) {
          passedCounts[xid] = (passedCounts[xid] || 0) + 1;
          if (tier) {
            if (!memberTiers[xid]) memberTiers[xid] = [];
            memberTiers[xid].push(tier);
          }
          if (completedAt) {
            lastCompleted[xid] = Math.max(lastCompleted[xid] || 0, completedAt);
          }
        }
      }
    }
    const allIds = new Set([
      ...Object.keys(joinedCounts),
      ...Object.keys(passedCounts),
      ...Object.keys(memberTiers)
    ]);
    const intel = {};
    for (const xid of allIds) {
      const tiers = memberTiers[xid] || [];
      const counts = new Map();
      tiers.forEach(tier => counts.set(tier, (counts.get(tier) || 0) + 1));
      const average = tiers.length
        ? Math.max(1, Math.min(10, Math.round(tiers.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / tiers.length)))
        : 0;
      const preferredEntry = [...counts.entries()]
        .sort((a, b) => (b[1] - a[1]) || (b[0] - a[0]))[0] || [0, 0];
      intel[xid] = {
        average,
        preferred: preferredEntry[0] || 0,
        preferredCount: preferredEntry[1] || 0,
        highest: tiers.length ? Math.max(...tiers) : 0,
        joined: joinedCounts[xid] || 0,
        passed: passedCounts[xid] || 0,
        count: tiers.length,
        lastCompletedAt: lastCompleted[xid] || 0
      };
    }
    saveLS(OC_INTEL_KEY, {
      ts: now(),
      windowDays: OC_HISTORY_WINDOW_DAYS,
      members: intel
    });
    return intel;
  }
  function formatOutsideDuration(seconds) {
    const total = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(seconds) || 0));
    const days = Math.floor(total / 86400);
    const hours = Math.floor((total % 86400) / 3600);
    const minutes = Math.floor((total % 3600) / 60);
    if (days > 0) return `${days}d ${hours}h`;
    if (hours > 0) return `${hours}h ${minutes}m`;
    return `${Math.max(1, minutes)}m`;
  }
  function outsideClass(seconds) {
    if (seconds >= 3 * 86400) return "red";
    if (seconds >= 1 * 86400) return "orange";
    return "good";
  }

  async function tornApiFetch(path, apiKey) {
    const response = await fetch(`https://api.torn.com/v2${path}`, {
      method: "GET",
      headers: { "Authorization": `ApiKey ${apiKey}`, "Accept": "application/json" },
      credentials: "omit",
      cache: "no-store"
    });
    let data;
    try { data = await response.json(); }
    catch { throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}`); }
    const apiError = data?.error || data?.errors?.[0];
    if (!response.ok || apiError) throw new Error(String(apiError?.error || apiError?.message || data?.message || `HTTP ${response.status}`));
    return data;
  }
  async function fetchFactionCrimes(apiKey, force = false, pageCount = 4) {
    if (!apiKey) throw new Error("API key not configured");
    const cached = loadLS(OC_API_CACHE_KEY);
    if (!force && cached?.ts && (now() - cached.ts) < OC_API_CACHE_MS && Array.isArray(cached.crimes)) {
      return cached.crimes;
    }
    const all = [];
    let offset = 0;
    const cutoff = Math.floor(now() / 1000) - OC_HISTORY_WINDOW_SECONDS;
    for (let page = 0; page < pageCount; page++) {
      const query = new URLSearchParams({
        cat: "completed",
        limit: String(OC_API_PAGE_LIMIT),
        offset: String(offset),
        sort: "DESC"
      });
      const payload = await tornApiFetch(`/faction/crimes?${query}`, apiKey);
      const crimes = unwrapCrimeList(payload);
      all.push(...crimes.filter(crime => {
        const completedAt = crimeCompletedAt(crime);
        return !completedAt || completedAt >= cutoff;
      }));
      const oldestCompleted = crimes
        .map(crimeCompletedAt)
        .filter(Boolean)
        .sort((a, b) => a - b)[0] || 0;
      if (crimes.length < OC_API_PAGE_LIMIT || (oldestCompleted && oldestCompleted < cutoff)) break;
      offset += OC_API_PAGE_LIMIT;
    }
    saveLS(OC_API_CACHE_KEY, { ts: now(), crimes: all, cutoff });
    return all;
  }
  function apiCrimeStage(crime) {
    const status = crimeStatus(crime);
    if (status.includes("recruit")) return "Recruiting";
    if (status.includes("plan")) return "Planning";
    return "";
  }

  function apiSlotUserId(slot) {
    const candidates = [
      slot?.user?.id,
      slot?.user?.user_id,
      slot?.user_id,
      slot?.userid,
      slot?.member?.id,
      slot?.member?.user_id,
      slot?.player?.id
    ];
    for (const value of candidates) {
      if (/^\d+$/.test(String(value ?? ""))) {
        return String(value);
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  function apiSlotRoleName(slot) {
    const candidates = [
      slot?.position?.name,
      slot?.position,
      slot?.role?.name,
      slot?.role,
      slot?.role_name,
      slot?.roleName,
      slot?.name
    ];
    for (const value of candidates) {
      if (typeof value !== "string") continue;
      const clean = value.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
      if (clean && clean.length <= 80) return clean;
    }
    return "";
  }

  function apiCrimeName(crime) {
    const candidates = [
      crime?.name,
      crime?.crime?.name,
      crime?.title
    ];
    for (const value of candidates) {
      if (typeof value !== "string") continue;
      const clean = value.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
      if (clean && clean.length <= 100) return clean;
    }
    return "";
  }

  function apiSlotRequirement(slot) {
    const req =
      slot?.item_requirement ||
      slot?.itemRequirement ||
      slot?.required_item ||
      slot?.requiredItem ||
      null;

    if (!req || typeof req !== "object") {
      return null;
    }

    const id =
      req.id ??
      req.item_id ??
      req.itemId ??
      null;

    if (!isAllowedItemId(id)) {
      return null;
    }

    const availabilityValues = [
      req.is_available,
      req.available,
      req.has_item,
      req.hasItem
    ].filter(value => typeof value === "boolean");

    const isAvailable =
      availabilityValues.length
        ? availabilityValues[0]
        : null;

    return {
      id: String(id),
      isAvailable
    };
  }

  function apiCrimeSlots(crime) {
    const candidates = [
      crime?.slots,
      crime?.participants,
      crime?.members,
      crime?.crime?.slots
    ];
    for (const value of candidates) {
      if (Array.isArray(value)) return value;
      if (value && typeof value === "object") {
        const arr = Object.values(value).filter(
          slot => slot && typeof slot === "object"
        );
        if (arr.length) return arr;
      }
    }
    return [];
  }

  async function scanAvailableCrimesViaApi(
    targetStage = getCrimesStageLabel(),
    force = false
  ) {
    if (
      targetStage !== "Recruiting" &&
      targetStage !== "Planning"
    ) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        stage: targetStage,
        reason: "Not on Recruiting/Planning"
      };
    }

    const apiKey = getSharedApiKey();
    if (!apiKey) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        stage: targetStage,
        reason: "API key not configured"
      };
    }

    if (
      !force &&
      apiOcStageLastAt[targetStage] &&
      (now() - apiOcStageLastAt[targetStage]) <
        API_OC_AUTO_SCAN_MS
    ) {
      return {
        ok: true,
        cached: true,
        stage: targetStage
      };
    }

    if (apiOcStagePromises[targetStage]) {
      return apiOcStagePromises[targetStage];
    }

    apiOcStagePromises[targetStage] = (async () => {
      const query = new URLSearchParams({
        cat: "available",
        limit: "100",
        sort: "ASC"
      });

      const payload =
        await tornApiFetch(
          `/faction/crimes?${query}`,
          apiKey
        );

      const crimes = unwrapCrimeList(payload);
      const byStage = {
        Recruiting: {
          usersInOC: new Set(),
          reqByUser: {},
          missingByUser: {},
          roleByUser: {},
          crimeByUser: {}
        },
        Planning: {
          usersInOC: new Set(),
          reqByUser: {},
          missingByUser: {},
          roleByUser: {},
          crimeByUser: {}
        }
      };

      for (const crime of crimes) {
        const stage = apiCrimeStage(crime);
        if (!stage || !byStage[stage]) continue;

        for (const slot of apiCrimeSlots(crime)) {
          const xid = apiSlotUserId(slot);
          if (!xid) continue;

          const stageData = byStage[stage];
          stageData.usersInOC.add(xid);

          const roleName =
            apiSlotRoleName(slot);
          const crimeName =
            apiCrimeName(crime);

          if (roleName) {
            stageData.roleByUser[xid] =
              roleName;
          }
          if (crimeName) {
            stageData.crimeByUser[xid] =
              crimeName;
          }

          const requirement =
            apiSlotRequirement(slot);

          if (!requirement) continue;

          if (!stageData.reqByUser[xid]) {
            stageData.reqByUser[xid] = [];
          }
          if (
            !stageData.reqByUser[xid].includes(
              requirement.id
            )
          ) {
            stageData.reqByUser[xid].push(
              requirement.id
            );
          }

          if (requirement.isAvailable === false) {
            if (!stageData.missingByUser[xid]) {
              stageData.missingByUser[xid] = [];
            }
            if (
              !stageData.missingByUser[xid].includes(
                requirement.id
              )
            ) {
              stageData.missingByUser[xid].push(
                requirement.id
              );
            }
          }
        }
      }

      const data =
        byStage[targetStage];

      writeScan({
        stage: targetStage,
        ts: now(),
        source: "api",
        usersInOC: [...data.usersInOC],
        reqByUser: data.reqByUser,
        missingByUser: data.missingByUser,
        roleByUser: data.roleByUser,
        crimeByUser: data.crimeByUser
      });

      apiOcStageLastAt[targetStage] = now();

      log("API OC scan saved:", {
        crimes: crimes.length,
        targetStage,
        recruiting: byStage.Recruiting.usersInOC.size,
        planning: byStage.Planning.usersInOC.size
      });

      return {
        ok: true,
        source: "api",
        stage: targetStage,
        crimes: crimes.length
      };
    })()
      .catch(error => {
        log("API OC auto scan failed:", error);
        return {
          ok: false,
          reason: error?.message || "API scan failed"
        };
      })
      .finally(() => {
        apiOcStagePromises[targetStage] =
          null;
      });

    return apiOcStagePromises[targetStage];
  }

  function calculateMemberIntelligence(crimes) {
    const memberTiers = {};
    const lastCompleted = {};
    const joinedCounts = {};
    const passedCounts = {};
    const cutoff = Math.floor(now() / 1000) - OC_HISTORY_WINDOW_SECONDS;
    for (const crime of crimes || []) {
      const completedAt = crimeCompletedAt(crime);
      if (completedAt && completedAt < cutoff) continue;
      const tier = crimeTier(crime);
      const status = crimeStatus(crime);
      const passed = !status || /(success|successful|completed|complete|executed|passed)/i.test(status);
      const members = crimeMemberIds(crime);
      for (const xid of members) {
        joinedCounts[xid] = (joinedCounts[xid] || 0) + 1;
        if (passed) {
          passedCounts[xid] = (passedCounts[xid] || 0) + 1;
          if (tier) {
            if (!memberTiers[xid]) memberTiers[xid] = [];
            memberTiers[xid].push(tier);
          }
          if (completedAt) {
            lastCompleted[xid] = Math.max(lastCompleted[xid] || 0, completedAt);
          }
        }
      }
    }
    const allIds = new Set([
      ...Object.keys(joinedCounts),
      ...Object.keys(passedCounts),
      ...Object.keys(memberTiers)
    ]);
    const intel = {};
    for (const xid of allIds) {
      const tiers = memberTiers[xid] || [];
      const counts = new Map();
      tiers.forEach(tier => counts.set(tier, (counts.get(tier) || 0) + 1));
      const average = tiers.length
        ? Math.max(1, Math.min(10, Math.round(tiers.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / tiers.length)))
        : 0;
      const preferredEntry = [...counts.entries()]
        .sort((a, b) => (b[1] - a[1]) || (b[0] - a[0]))[0] || [0, 0];
      intel[xid] = {
        average,
        preferred: preferredEntry[0] || 0,
        preferredCount: preferredEntry[1] || 0,
        highest: tiers.length ? Math.max(...tiers) : 0,
        joined: joinedCounts[xid] || 0,
        passed: passedCounts[xid] || 0,
        count: tiers.length,
        lastCompletedAt: lastCompleted[xid] || 0
      };
    }
    saveLS(OC_INTEL_KEY, {
      ts: now(),
      windowDays: OC_HISTORY_WINDOW_DAYS,
      members: intel
    });
    return intel;
  }
  function formatOutsideDuration(seconds) {
    const total = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(seconds) || 0));
    const days = Math.floor(total / 86400);
    const hours = Math.floor((total % 86400) / 3600);
    const minutes = Math.floor((total % 3600) / 60);
    if (days > 0) return `${days}d ${hours}h`;
    if (hours > 0) return `${hours}h ${minutes}m`;
    return `${Math.max(1, minutes)}m`;
  }

    if (seconds >= 3 * 86400) return "red";
    if (seconds >= 1 * 86400) return "orange";
    return "good";
  }

  function apiSlotRequirement(slot) {
    const req =
      slot?.item_requirement ||
      slot?.itemRequirement ||
      slot?.required_item ||
      slot?.requiredItem ||
      null;

    if (!req || typeof req !== "object") {
      return null;
    }

    const id =
      req.id ??
      req.item_id ??
      req.itemId ??
      null;

    if (!isAllowedItemId(id)) {
      return null;
    }

    const availabilityValues = [
      req.is_available,
      req.available,
      req.has_item,
      req.hasItem
    ].filter(value => typeof value === "boolean");

    const isAvailable =
      availabilityValues.length
        ? availabilityValues[0]
        : null;

    return {
      id: String(id),
      isAvailable
    };
  }

  function apiCrimeSlots(crime) {
    const candidates = [
      crime?.slots,
      crime?.participants,
      crime?.members,
      crime?.crime?.slots
    ];
    for (const value of candidates) {
      if (Array.isArray(value)) return value;
      if (value && typeof value === "object") {
        const arr = Object.values(value).filter(
          slot => slot && typeof slot === "object"
        );
        if (arr.length) return arr;
      }
    }
    return [];
  }

  async function scanAvailableCrimesViaApi(
    targetStage = getCrimesStageLabel(),
    force = false
  ) {
    if (
      targetStage !== "Recruiting" &&
      targetStage !== "Planning"
    ) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        stage: targetStage,
        reason: "Not on Recruiting/Planning"
      };
    }

    const apiKey = getSharedApiKey();
    if (!apiKey) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        stage: targetStage,
        reason: "API key not configured"
      };
    }

    if (
      !force &&
      apiOcStageLastAt[targetStage] &&
      (now() - apiOcStageLastAt[targetStage]) <
        API_OC_AUTO_SCAN_MS
    ) {
      return {
        ok: true,
        cached: true,
        stage: targetStage
      };
    }

    if (apiOcStagePromises[targetStage]) {
      return apiOcStagePromises[targetStage];
    }

    apiOcStagePromises[targetStage] = (async () => {
      const query = new URLSearchParams({
        cat: "available",
        limit: "100",
        sort: "ASC"
      });

      const payload =
        await tornApiFetch(
          `/faction/crimes?${query}`,
          apiKey
        );

      const crimes = unwrapCrimeList(payload);
      const byStage = {
        Recruiting: {
          usersInOC: new Set(),
          reqByUser: {},
          missingByUser: {},
          roleByUser: {},
          crimeByUser: {}
        },
        Planning: {
          usersInOC: new Set(),
          reqByUser: {},
          missingByUser: {},
          roleByUser: {},
          crimeByUser: {}
        }
      };

      for (const crime of crimes) {
        const stage = apiCrimeStage(crime);
        if (!stage || !byStage[stage]) continue;

        for (const slot of apiCrimeSlots(crime)) {
          const xid = apiSlotUserId(slot);
          if (!xid) continue;

          const stageData = byStage[stage];
          stageData.usersInOC.add(xid);

          const roleName =
            apiSlotRoleName(slot);
          const crimeName =
            apiCrimeName(crime);

          if (roleName) {
            stageData.roleByUser[xid] =
              roleName;
          }
          if (crimeName) {
            stageData.crimeByUser[xid] =
              crimeName;
          }

          const requirement =
            apiSlotRequirement(slot);

          if (!requirement) continue;

          if (!stageData.reqByUser[xid]) {
            stageData.reqByUser[xid] = [];
          }
          if (
            !stageData.reqByUser[xid].includes(
              requirement.id
            )
          ) {
            stageData.reqByUser[xid].push(
              requirement.id
            );
          }

          if (requirement.isAvailable === false) {
            if (!stageData.missingByUser[xid]) {
              stageData.missingByUser[xid] = [];
            }
            if (
              !stageData.missingByUser[xid].includes(
                requirement.id
              )
            ) {
              stageData.missingByUser[xid].push(
                requirement.id
              );
            }
          }
        }
      }

      const data =
        byStage[targetStage];

      writeScan({
        stage: targetStage,
        ts: now(),
        source: "api",
        usersInOC: [...data.usersInOC],
        reqByUser: data.reqByUser,
        missingByUser: data.missingByUser,
        roleByUser: data.roleByUser,
        crimeByUser: data.crimeByUser
      });

      apiOcStageLastAt[targetStage] = now();

      log("API OC scan saved:", {
        crimes: crimes.length,
        targetStage,
        recruiting: byStage.Recruiting.usersInOC.size,
        planning: byStage.Planning.usersInOC.size
      });

      return {
        ok: true,
        source: "api",
        stage: targetStage,
        crimes: crimes.length
      };
    })()
      .catch(error => {
        log("API OC auto scan failed:", error);
        return {
          ok: false,
          reason: error?.message || "API scan failed"
        };
      })
      .finally(() => {
        apiOcStagePromises[targetStage] =
          null;
      });

    return apiOcStagePromises[targetStage];
  }

  function calculateMemberIntelligence(crimes) {
    const memberTiers = {};
    const lastCompleted = {};
    const joinedCounts = {};
    const passedCounts = {};
    const cutoff = Math.floor(now() / 1000) - OC_HISTORY_WINDOW_SECONDS;
    for (const crime of crimes || []) {
      const completedAt = crimeCompletedAt(crime);
      if (completedAt && completedAt < cutoff) continue;
      const tier = crimeTier(crime);
      const status = crimeStatus(crime);
      const passed = !status || /(success|successful|completed|complete|executed|passed)/i.test(status);
      const members = crimeMemberIds(crime);
      for (const xid of members) {
        joinedCounts[xid] = (joinedCounts[xid] || 0) + 1;
        if (passed) {
          passedCounts[xid] = (passedCounts[xid] || 0) + 1;
          if (tier) {
            if (!memberTiers[xid]) memberTiers[xid] = [];
            memberTiers[xid].push(tier);
          }
          if (completedAt) {
            lastCompleted[xid] = Math.max(lastCompleted[xid] || 0, completedAt);
          }
        }
      }
    }
    const allIds = new Set([
      ...Object.keys(joinedCounts),
      ...Object.keys(passedCounts),
      ...Object.keys(memberTiers)
    ]);
    const intel = {};
    for (const xid of allIds) {
      const tiers = memberTiers[xid] || [];
      const counts = new Map();
      tiers.forEach(tier => counts.set(tier, (counts.get(tier) || 0) + 1));
      const average = tiers.length
        ? Math.max(1, Math.min(10, Math.round(tiers.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / tiers.length)))
        : 0;
      const preferredEntry = [...counts.entries()]
        .sort((a, b) => (b[1] - a[1]) || (b[0] - a[0]))[0] || [0, 0];
      intel[xid] = {
        average,
        preferred: preferredEntry[0] || 0,
        preferredCount: preferredEntry[1] || 0,
        highest: tiers.length ? Math.max(...tiers) : 0,
        joined: joinedCounts[xid] || 0,
        passed: passedCounts[xid] || 0,
        count: tiers.length,
        lastCompletedAt: lastCompleted[xid] || 0
      };
    }
    saveLS(OC_INTEL_KEY, {
      ts: now(),
      windowDays: OC_HISTORY_WINDOW_DAYS,
      members: intel
    });
    return intel;
  }
  function formatOutsideDuration(seconds) {
    const total = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(seconds) || 0));
    const days = Math.floor(total / 86400);
    const hours = Math.floor((total % 86400) / 3600);
    const minutes = Math.floor((total % 3600) / 60);
    if (days > 0) return `${days}d ${hours}h`;
    if (hours > 0) return `${hours}h ${minutes}m`;
    return `${Math.max(1, minutes)}m`;
  }
  function outsideClass(seconds) {
    if (seconds >= 3 * 86400) return "red";
    if (seconds >= 1 * 86400) return "orange";
    return "good";
  }

  function getNotInvolvedCards() {
    const box = getNotInvolvedBox();
    if (!box) return [];

    const profileLinks = Array.from(
      box.querySelectorAll('a[href*="profiles.php?XID="]')
    );

    const seen = new Set();
    const cards = [];

    for (const link of profileLinks) {
      const xid = xidFromHref(link.getAttribute("href"));
      if (!xid || seen.has(String(xid))) continue;
      seen.add(String(xid));

      const row =
        link.closest('li[class*="item"]') ||
        link.closest("li") ||
        link.closest('[class*="member"]') ||
        link.closest('[class*="item"]') ||
        link.parentElement ||
        box;

      const honorImg =
        row.querySelector?.('img[alt]') ||
        link.querySelector?.('img[alt]');

      const plainHonor = Array.from(
        row.querySelectorAll?.("span.honor-text") || []
      )
        .map(el => (el.textContent || "").trim())
        .find(Boolean);

      const symbolName = Array.from(
        row.querySelectorAll?.('[class*="honorTextSymbol"]') || []
      )
        .map(el => el.dataset.char || "")
        .join("")
        .trim();

      const ariaName = String(
        link.getAttribute("aria-label") || ""
      )
        .replace(/^View profile of\s+/i, "")
        .trim();

      const linkText = String(link.textContent || "")
        .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
        .trim();

      const name =
        honorImg?.getAttribute("alt")?.trim() ||
        plainHonor ||
        symbolName ||
        ariaName ||
        linkText ||
        `Member #${xid}`;

      cards.push({ li: row, link, xid: String(xid), name });
    }

    return cards;
  }
  function syncOutsideTracking(cards, intel) {
    const state = readOutsideState();
    const currentIds = new Set(cards.map(c => c.xid));
    const currentUnix = Math.floor(now() / 1000);
    for (const card of cards) {
      const lastCompleted = Number(intel?.[card.xid]?.lastCompletedAt || 0);
      state[card.xid] = lastCompleted || Number(state[card.xid] || 0) || currentUnix;
    }
    for (const xid of Object.keys(state)) if (!currentIds.has(xid)) delete state[xid];
    saveOutsideState(state);
    return state;
  }
  function bindOcIntelSorting(panel) {
    const body = panel.querySelector(".sakalux-oco-intel-panel-body");
    if (!body) return;
    panel.querySelectorAll(".sakalux-oco-sort-btn").forEach(btn => {
      if (btn.dataset.sakaluxSortBound === "1") return;
      btn.dataset.sakaluxSortBound = "1";
      btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const key = btn.dataset.sort;
        const currentKey = panel.dataset.sortKey;
        const currentDir = panel.dataset.sortDir || "desc";
        const nextDir = currentKey === key && currentDir === "desc" ? "asc" : "desc";
        panel.dataset.sortKey = key;
        panel.dataset.sortDir = nextDir;
        panel.querySelectorAll(".sakalux-oco-sort-btn").forEach(b => {
          b.classList.toggle("active", b === btn);
          b.dataset.dir = b === btn ? nextDir : "";
        });
        const rows = Array.from(body.querySelectorAll(".sakalux-oco-intel-panel-row"));
        rows.sort((a, b) => {
          if (key === "name") {
            const av = a.dataset.name || "";
            const bv = b.dataset.name || "";
            return nextDir === "asc" ? av.localeCompare(bv) : bv.localeCompare(av);
          }
          const av = Number(a.dataset[key] || 0);
          const bv = Number(b.dataset[key] || 0);
          return nextDir === "asc" ? av - bv : bv - av;
        });
        rows.forEach(row => body.appendChild(row));
      });
    });
  }

  let ocIntelPromise = null;
  async function refreshOcIntelligence(force = false) {
    if (!isCrimesTab() || !getNotInvolvedBox()) return;
    renderOcIntelligence(null, true);
    const apiKey = getSharedApiKey();
    if (!apiKey) { renderOcIntelligence(null, false, "Add a Torn API key in Master Settings."); return; }
    if (ocIntelPromise && !force) return ocIntelPromise;
    ocIntelPromise = (async () => {
      try {
        const crimes = await fetchFactionCrimes(apiKey, force);
        const intel = calculateMemberIntelligence(crimes);
        renderOcIntelligence(intel);
      } catch (err) {
        renderOcIntelligence(null, false, `OC Intelligence error: ${err.message || err}`);
        throw err;
      } finally { ocIntelPromise = null; }
    })();
    return ocIntelPromise;
  }

  let ocIntelPromise = null;
  async function refreshOcIntelligence(force = false) {
    if (!isCrimesTab() || !getNotInvolvedBox()) return;
    renderOcIntelligence(null, true);
    const apiKey = getSharedApiKey();
    if (!apiKey) { renderOcIntelligence(null, false, "Add a Torn API key in Master Settings."); return; }
    if (ocIntelPromise && !force) return ocIntelPromise;
    ocIntelPromise = (async () => {
      try {
        const crimes = await fetchFactionCrimes(apiKey, force);
        const intel = calculateMemberIntelligence(crimes);
        renderOcIntelligence(intel);
      } catch (err) {
        renderOcIntelligence(null, false, `OC Intelligence error: ${err.message || err}`);
        throw err;
      } finally { ocIntelPromise = null; }
    })();
    return ocIntelPromise;
  }
  function sessionScanSummary() {
    return `Recruiting ${sessionScanState.Recruiting ? "✓" : "·"} | Planning ${sessionScanState.Planning ? "✓" : "·"}`;
  }
  function sessionScanStatusHTML() {
    const recDone = !!sessionScanState.Recruiting;
    const planDone = !!sessionScanState.Planning;
    return `
        <span class="sakalux-oco-scan-line ${recDone ? "is-done" : "is-pending"}">
          <span>Recruiting</span><b>${recDone ? "✓" : "·"}</b>
        </span>
        <span class="sakalux-oco-scan-line ${planDone ? "is-done" : "is-pending"}">
          <span>Planning</span><b>${planDone ? "✓" : "·"}</b>
        </span>`;
  }
  function sessionScanTooltip() {
    return [
      sessionScanState.Recruiting ? "Recruiting - Scan Complete" : "Recruiting - Scan Required",
      sessionScanState.Planning ? "Planning - Scan Complete" : "Planning - Scan Required"
    ].join(" • ");
  }

  let ocIntelPromise = null;
  async function refreshOcIntelligence(force = false) {
    if (!isCrimesTab() || !getNotInvolvedBox()) return;
    renderOcIntelligence(null, true);
    const apiKey = getSharedApiKey();
    if (!apiKey) { renderOcIntelligence(null, false, "Add a Torn API key in Master Settings."); return; }
    if (ocIntelPromise && !force) return ocIntelPromise;
    ocIntelPromise = (async () => {
      try {
        const crimes = await fetchFactionCrimes(apiKey, force);
        const intel = calculateMemberIntelligence(crimes);
        renderOcIntelligence(intel);
      } catch (err) {
        renderOcIntelligence(null, false, `OC Intelligence error: ${err.message || err}`);
        throw err;
      } finally { ocIntelPromise = null; }
    })();
    return ocIntelPromise;
  }
  function sessionScanSummary() {
    return `Recruiting ${sessionScanState.Recruiting ? "✓" : "·"} | Planning ${sessionScanState.Planning ? "✓" : "·"}`;
  }
  function sessionScanStatusHTML() {
    const recDone = !!sessionScanState.Recruiting;
    const planDone = !!sessionScanState.Planning;
    return `
        <span class="sakalux-oco-scan-line ${recDone ? "is-done" : "is-pending"}">
          <span>Recruiting</span><b>${recDone ? "✓" : "·"}</b>
        </span>
        <span class="sakalux-oco-scan-line ${planDone ? "is-done" : "is-pending"}">
          <span>Planning</span><b>${planDone ? "✓" : "·"}</b>
        </span>`;
  }
  function sessionScanTooltip() {
    return [
      sessionScanState.Recruiting ? "Recruiting - Scan Complete" : "Recruiting - Scan Required",
      sessionScanState.Planning ? "Planning - Scan Complete" : "Planning - Scan Required"
    ].join(" • ");
  }

  let ocIntelPromise = null;
  async function refreshOcIntelligence(force = false) {
    if (!isCrimesTab() || !getNotInvolvedBox()) return;
    renderOcIntelligence(null, true);
    const apiKey = getSharedApiKey();
    if (!apiKey) { renderOcIntelligence(null, false, "Add a Torn API key in Master Settings."); return; }
    if (ocIntelPromise && !force) return ocIntelPromise;
    ocIntelPromise = (async () => {
      try {
        const crimes = await fetchFactionCrimes(apiKey, force);
        const intel = calculateMemberIntelligence(crimes);
        renderOcIntelligence(intel);
      } catch (err) {
        renderOcIntelligence(null, false, `OC Intelligence error: ${err.message || err}`);
        throw err;
      } finally { ocIntelPromise = null; }
    })();
    return ocIntelPromise;
  }
  function sessionScanSummary() {
    return `Recruiting ${sessionScanState.Recruiting ? "✓" : "·"} | Planning ${sessionScanState.Planning ? "✓" : "·"}`;
  }
  function sessionScanStatusHTML() {
    const recDone = !!sessionScanState.Recruiting;
    const planDone = !!sessionScanState.Planning;
    return `
        <span class="sakalux-oco-scan-line ${recDone ? "is-done" : "is-pending"}">
          <span>Recruiting</span><b>${recDone ? "✓" : "·"}</b>
        </span>
        <span class="sakalux-oco-scan-line ${planDone ? "is-done" : "is-pending"}">
          <span>Planning</span><b>${planDone ? "✓" : "·"}</b>
        </span>`;
  }
  function sessionScanTooltip() {
    return [
      sessionScanState.Recruiting ? "Recruiting - Scan Complete" : "Recruiting - Scan Required",
      sessionScanState.Planning ? "Planning - Scan Complete" : "Planning - Scan Required"
    ].join(" • ");
  }

  let ocIntelPromise = null;
  async function refreshOcIntelligence(force = false) {
    if (!isCrimesTab() || !getNotInvolvedBox()) return;
    renderOcIntelligence(null, true);
    const apiKey = getSharedApiKey();
    if (!apiKey) { renderOcIntelligence(null, false, "Add a Torn API key in Master Settings."); return; }
    if (ocIntelPromise && !force) return ocIntelPromise;
    ocIntelPromise = (async () => {
      try {
        const crimes = await fetchFactionCrimes(apiKey, force);
        const intel = calculateMemberIntelligence(crimes);
        renderOcIntelligence(intel);
      } catch (err) {
        renderOcIntelligence(null, false, `OC Intelligence error: ${err.message || err}`);
        throw err;
      } finally { ocIntelPromise = null; }
    })();
    return ocIntelPromise;
  }

  function startHud() {
    if (hudEl()) return;
    const hud = document.createElement("div");
    hud.id = HUD_ID;
    hud.className = "sakalux-oco-panel";
    hud.innerHTML = `
      <div class="sakalux-oco-hud-header">
        <span>OC Role Match + Readiness</span>
        <button class="sakalux-oco-btn icon" id="sakalux-oco-hud-gear" type="button" title="Settings">⚙</button>
      </div>
      <div class="sakalux-oco-hud-row" id="sakalux-oco-hud-oc"></div>
      <div class="sakalux-oco-hud-row" id="sakalux-oco-hud-item"></div>`;
    document.body.appendChild(hud);
    makeDraggable(hud);
    hud.querySelector("#sakalux-oco-hud-gear").onclick = showSettings;
    hudInterval = setInterval(() => {
      const ocR = ocRemaining();
      const itmR = itmRemaining();
      const ocRow = document.getElementById("sakalux-oco-hud-oc");
      const itmRow = document.getElementById("sakalux-oco-hud-item");
      if (ocRow) ocRow.textContent = ocR > 0 ? `OC reminder back in ${ocR}s` : "";
      if (itmRow) itmRow.textContent = itmR > 0 ? `Item alert back in ${itmR}s` : "";
      if (ocR <= 0 && itmR <= 0) {
        removeHud();
        evaluate();
      }
    }, 250);
  }
  function makeDraggable(hud) {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem(HUD_POS_KEY);
    if (saved) {
      try {
        const p = JSON.parse(saved);
        hud.style.left = p.x + "px";
        hud.style.top = p.y + "px";
        hud.style.right = "auto";
      } catch (e) {}
    }
    let dragging = false, ox = 0, oy = 0;
    hud.onmousedown = e => {
      if (e.target.closest(".sakalux-oco-btn")) return;
      dragging = true;
      ox = e.clientX - hud.offsetLeft;
      oy = e.clientY - hud.offsetTop;
    };
    document.onmousemove = e => {
      if (!dragging) return;
      hud.style.left = (e.clientX - ox) + "px";
      hud.style.top = (e.clientY - oy) + "px";
      hud.style.right = "auto";
    };
    document.onmouseup = () => {
      if (dragging) {
        const h = hudEl();
        if (h) localStorage.setItem(HUD_POS_KEY, JSON.stringify({ x: h.offsetLeft, y: h.offsetTop }));
      }
      dragging = false;
    };
  }
  function evaluate() {
    if (!moduleActive) return;
    if (isExcludedPage()) {
      removePopup();
      if (!itmIsDismissed()) removeHud();
      ocMissingSince = 0;
      return;
    }
    if ((Date.now() - scriptStartedAt) < STARTUP_GRACE_MS) return;
    if (!hasSidebarIconArea()) {
      ocMissingSince = 0;
      return;
    }
    if (hasOcIcon()) {
      ocMissingSince = 0;
      ocClearDismiss();
      removePopup();
      if (!itmIsDismissed()) removeHud();
      return;
    }
    if (!ocMissingSince) ocMissingSince = Date.now();
    if ((Date.now() - ocMissingSince) < OC_STABLE_MISS_MS) return;
    if (ocIsDismissed()) {
      removePopup();
      if (!hudEl()) startHud();
    } else {
      showPopup();
    }
  }
  function canonicalize(d) {
    return String(d || "").toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, "").replace(/-?\d*\.?\d+/g, "0");
  }
  const CANON_PATH = canonicalize(MISSING_PATH);

        element.closest?.('div[class*="wrapper"]') ||
        element.closest?.('[class*="slot"]') ||
        element.parentElement;
      if(root)roots.push(root);
    };
    findActionButtons().forEach(add);
    document.querySelectorAll(
      [
        '[class*="contentLayer"] [class*="slotBody"]',
        '[class*="contentLayer"] [class*="slotHeader"]',
        '[data-oc-id] [class*="slotBody"]',
        '[data-oc-id] a[href*="profiles.php?XID="]',
        '[data-oc-id] [data-user-id]',
        '[data-oc-id] [data-xid]'
      ].join(",")
    ).forEach(add);
    return [...new Set(roots)]
      .filter(root =>
        root.querySelector?.(
          '[class*="slotBody"],[class*="slotHeader"],a[href*="profiles.php?XID="],[data-user-id],[data-xid]'
        )
      )
      .slice(0,MAX_SLOT_ROOTS);
  }
  function collectMenuProfileLinks() {
    return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a[href*="profiles.php?XID="]'))
      .filter(a => /view profile/i.test(a.textContent) || a.closest('div[class*="slotMenu"]'))
      .map(a => a.getAttribute("href"))
      .filter(Boolean);
  }
  function dispatchSafeMouseEvent(element, type) {
    if (!element) return;
    try {
      element.dispatchEvent(
        new MouseEvent(type, {
          bubbles: true,
          cancelable: true
        })
      );
    } catch {
      element.dispatchEvent(
        new Event(type, {
          bubbles: true,
          cancelable: true
        })
      );
    }
  }
  async function openMenuAndGetXid(slotRoot) {
    const btn = findActionButtons().find(b => slotRoot.contains(b));
    if (!btn) return null;
    const before = new Set(collectMenuProfileLinks());
    const btnCenter = rectCenter(btn);
    dispatchSafeMouseEvent(btn, "mousedown");
    dispatchSafeMouseEvent(btn, "mouseup");
    btn.click();
    await sleep(Math.max(MENU_OPEN_MS,420));
    const allLinks = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a[href*="profiles.php?XID="]'));
    const isMenuLink = a => /view profile/i.test(a.textContent) || a.closest('div[class*="slotMenu"]');
    let candidates = allLinks.filter(a => {
      const href = a.getAttribute("href");
      return href && !before.has(href) && isMenuLink(a);
    });
    if (!candidates.length) candidates = allLinks.filter(isMenuLink);
    const best = candidates.sort((a, b) => dist(rectCenter(a), btnCenter) - dist(rectCenter(b), btnCenter))[0];
    const xid = xidFromHref(best?.getAttribute("href"));
    if(btn.isConnected){
      btn.click();
      await sleep(MENU_CLOSE_MS);
    }
    return xid ?? null;
  }
  function getAllTooltips() {
    return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[role="tooltip"], div[class*="tooltip"]'));
  }
  async function hoverAndGetTooltip(host) {
    if (!host) return null;
    const before = new Set(getAllTooltips().map(t => t.id).filter(Boolean));
    const hostCenter = rectCenter(host);
    dispatchSafeMouseEvent(host, "mouseenter");
    dispatchSafeMouseEvent(host, "mouseover");
    await sleep(TOOLTIP_OPEN_DELAY);
    const tipId = host.getAttribute("aria-describedby");
    let tip = tipId ? document.getElementById(tipId) : null;
    if (!tip) {
      const all = getAllTooltips();
      const candidates = all.filter(t => !t.id || !before.has(t.id));
      const pool = candidates.length ? candidates : all;
      if (pool.length) {
        tip = pool.sort((a, b) => dist(rectCenter(a), hostCenter) - dist(rectCenter(b), hostCenter))[0];
      }
    }
    dispatchSafeMouseEvent(host, "mouseleave");
    dispatchSafeMouseEvent(host, "mouseout");
    await sleep(TOOLTIP_CLOSE_DELAY);
    return tip ?? null;
  }
  function extractItemIdFromTooltip(tip) {
    if (!tip) return null;
    const text = (tip.textContent || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ");
    const html = tip.innerHTML || "";
    const aria = tip.querySelector("[aria-label]")?.getAttribute("aria-label") || "";
    const check = s => /used item\s*:|required item\s*:/i.test(s);
    if (!check(text) && !check(html) && !check(aria)) return null;
    const img = tip.querySelector('img[src*="/images/items/"]');
    return itemIdFromSrc(img?.getAttribute("src")) ?? (html + text).match(/\/images\/items\/(\d+)\//i)?.[1] ?? null;
  }
  function getCrimesStageLabel() {
    const { recruitingBtn, planningBtn, completedBtn, stageButtons } = getStageButtons();
    const btns = stageButtons?.length ? stageButtons : [recruitingBtn, planningBtn, completedBtn].filter(Boolean);
    const active = btns.find(isActiveStageButton) || btns.find(b => {
      const aria = String(b.getAttribute("aria-selected") || b.getAttribute("aria-current") || "").toLowerCase();
      return aria === "true" || aria === "page";
    });
    const txt = (active?.textContent || "").trim();
    if (/recruit/i.test(txt)) return "Recruiting";
    if (/plan/i.test(txt)) return "Planning";
    if (/compl/i.test(txt)) return "Completed";
    return txt || "Unknown";
  }
  function directSlotXid(slotRoot) {
    if(!slotRoot)return null;
    const link = slotRoot.querySelector(
      'a[href*="profiles.php?XID="],a[href*="/profiles.php?XID="]'
    );
    const fromLink=xidFromHref(link?.getAttribute("href"));
    if(fromLink)return fromLink;
    const dataElement=slotRoot.querySelector(
      "[data-user-id],[data-xid],[data-user]"
    );
    const dataValue=
      dataElement?.dataset?.userId ||
      dataElement?.dataset?.xid ||
      dataElement?.dataset?.user ||
      dataElement?.getAttribute("data-user-id") ||
      dataElement?.getAttribute("data-xid") ||
      dataElement?.getAttribute("data-user");
    if(/^\d+$/.test(String(dataValue||""))){
      return String(dataValue);
    }
    const html=slotRoot.innerHTML||"";
    const match=html.match(
      /(?:XID=|data-(?:user-id|xid)=["']?)(\d+)/i
    );
    return match?.[1]||null;
  }
  function directSlotItemId(slotRoot) {
    if (!slotRoot) return null;
    const images = Array.from(
      slotRoot.querySelectorAll('img[src*="/images/items/"]')
    );
    for (const image of images) {
      const id = itemIdFromSrc(image.getAttribute("src"));
      if (isAllowedItemId(id)) return String(id);
    }
    const dataItem = slotRoot.querySelector(
      "[data-itemid],[data-item-id]"
    );
    const dataId =
      dataItem?.dataset?.itemid ||
      dataItem?.dataset?.itemId ||
      dataItem?.getAttribute("data-itemid") ||
      dataItem?.getAttribute("data-item-id");
    return isAllowedItemId(dataId) ? String(dataId) : null;
  }
  async function scanCurrentCrimesStage() {
    const stage = getCrimesStageLabel();
    refreshNotInOCFromPage();
    if (stage !== "Recruiting" && stage !== "Planning") {
      return { ok: false, stage, reason: "Not on Recruiting/Planning" };
    }
    const usersInOC = new Set();
    const reqByUser = {};
    const roleByUser = {};
    const roots = findSlotRoots();
    for (const root of roots) {
      let xid = directSlotXid(root);
      if (!xid) {
        xid = await openMenuAndGetXid(root);
      }
      if (!xid) continue;
      usersInOC.add(xid);
      if (!reqByUser[xid]) {
        reqByUser[xid] = [];
      }

      const roleName =
        (
          root.querySelector(
            '[class*="title"], [class*="role"]'
          )?.textContent ||
          ""
        )
          .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
          .trim();

      if (roleName) {
        roleByUser[xid] = roleName;
      }

      let itemId = directSlotItemId(root);
      if (!itemId) {
        const hoverHost =
          root.querySelector(
            'button[class*="slotHeader"],[class*="slotHeader"]'
          ) ||
          root.querySelector('[aria-describedby]') ||
          root;
        const tip = await hoverAndGetTooltip(hoverHost);
        itemId = extractItemIdFromTooltip(tip);
      }
      if (isAllowedItemId(itemId)) {
        const sid = String(itemId);
        if (!reqByUser[xid].includes(sid)) {
          reqByUser[xid].push(sid);
        }
      }
    }
    if (!roots.length || !usersInOC.size) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        stage,
        reason: "No OC role slots found"
      };
    }
    const scan = {
      stage,
      ts: now(),
      source: "dom",
      usersInOC: [...usersInOC],
      reqByUser,
      missingByUser: {},
      roleByUser
    };
    writeScan(scan);
    sessionScanState[stage] = true;
    log("Scan saved:", { stage, users: scan.usersInOC.length });
    return { ok: true, stage, scan };
  }
  function ensureLegend() {
    const header =
      document.querySelector("li.item-title") ||
      document.querySelector(
        '[class*="armoury"] [class*="title"], [class*="utilities"] [class*="title"]'
      );
    if (!header) return;

    header.classList.add(
      "sakalux-oco-legend-host"
    );

    if (header.querySelector(".sakalux-oco-legend")) return;

    const legend = document.createElement("span");
    legend.className = "sakalux-oco-legend";
    legend.title = "Green = Required • Yellow = Not Required • Red = Not in OC";
    legend.innerHTML = `
      <span class="sakalux-oco-legend-item"><span class="sakalux-oco-legend-dot green"></span>Required</span>
      <span class="sakalux-oco-legend-item"><span class="sakalux-oco-legend-dot yellow"></span>Not Required</span>
      <span class="sakalux-oco-legend-item"><span class="sakalux-oco-legend-dot red"></span>Not in OC</span>
    `;
    header.appendChild(legend);
  }
  function rowFromImgWrap(imgWrap) {
    let el = imgWrap.closest("li") || imgWrap.parentElement;
    for (let i = 0; i < 10 && el; i++) {
      const hasText = (el.textContent || "").trim().length > 0;
      const hasOptions = !!el.querySelector?.(".show-option-icon, .item-action, .give, .loan, .retrieve, [class*='options']");
      const r = el.getBoundingClientRect?.();
      if (hasText && hasOptions) return el;
      if (hasOptions && r?.height >= 34 && r?.height <= 160) return el;
      el = el.parentElement;
    }
    return imgWrap.closest("div") || imgWrap.parentElement || imgWrap;
  }
  function clearLoanedFlags() {
    document.querySelectorAll(".sakalux-oco-row").forEach(n => {
      n.classList.remove("sakalux-oco-row", "sakalux-oco-row--green", "sakalux-oco-row--yellow", "sakalux-oco-row--red");
      n.removeAttribute("title");
      delete n.dataset.sakaluxState;
    });
    document.querySelectorAll(".sakalux-oco-pill").forEach(n => n.remove());
    document.querySelectorAll(".sakalux-oco-retrieve-alert").forEach(n => {
      n.classList.remove("sakalux-oco-retrieve-alert");
      n.removeAttribute("title");
    });
  }
  function getArmoryItemEntries() {
    const entries = [];
    const seenRows = new Set();
    let candidates = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('div.img-wrap[data-itemid][data-armoryid], [data-itemid][data-armoryid]'));
    if (!candidates.length) {
      candidates = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('div.img-wrap[data-itemid], img[src*="/images/items/"]'));
    }
    for (const el of candidates) {
      const row = rowFromImgWrap(el);
      if (!row || seenRows.has(row)) continue;
      const rowText = (row.textContent || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
      const looksLikeArmoryRow = /\b(Give|Loan|Retrieve|Available)\b/i.test(rowText) || !!row.querySelector('a.retrieve, a.give, a.loan, [class*="loaned"]');
      if (!looksLikeArmoryRow) continue;
      const itemId = String(
        el.dataset?.itemid ||
        el.closest?.('[data-itemid]')?.dataset?.itemid ||
        itemIdFromSrc(el.getAttribute?.("src")) ||
        itemIdFromSrc(el.querySelector?.('img[src*="/images/items/"]')?.getAttribute("src")) ||
        ""
      );
      if (!isAllowedItemId(itemId)) continue;
      entries.push({ row, itemId });
      seenRows.add(row);
    }
    return entries;
  }

    const { usersInOC, reqByUser } = mergedScans();

  function getAllTooltips() {
    return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[role="tooltip"], div[class*="tooltip"]'));
  }
  async function hoverAndGetTooltip(host) {
    if (!host) return null;
    const before = new Set(getAllTooltips().map(t => t.id).filter(Boolean));
    const hostCenter = rectCenter(host);
    dispatchSafeMouseEvent(host, "mouseenter");
    dispatchSafeMouseEvent(host, "mouseover");
    await sleep(TOOLTIP_OPEN_DELAY);
    const tipId = host.getAttribute("aria-describedby");
    let tip = tipId ? document.getElementById(tipId) : null;
    if (!tip) {
      const all = getAllTooltips();
      const candidates = all.filter(t => !t.id || !before.has(t.id));
      const pool = candidates.length ? candidates : all;
      if (pool.length) {
        tip = pool.sort((a, b) => dist(rectCenter(a), hostCenter) - dist(rectCenter(b), hostCenter))[0];
      }
    }
    dispatchSafeMouseEvent(host, "mouseleave");
    dispatchSafeMouseEvent(host, "mouseout");
    await sleep(TOOLTIP_CLOSE_DELAY);
    return tip ?? null;
  }
  function extractItemIdFromTooltip(tip) {
    if (!tip) return null;
    const text = (tip.textContent || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ");
    const html = tip.innerHTML || "";
    const aria = tip.querySelector("[aria-label]")?.getAttribute("aria-label") || "";
    const check = s => /used item\s*:|required item\s*:/i.test(s);
    if (!check(text) && !check(html) && !check(aria)) return null;
    const img = tip.querySelector('img[src*="/images/items/"]');
    return itemIdFromSrc(img?.getAttribute("src")) ?? (html + text).match(/\/images\/items\/(\d+)\//i)?.[1] ?? null;
  }

  function directSlotXid(slotRoot) {
    if(!slotRoot)return null;
    const link = slotRoot.querySelector(
      'a[href*="profiles.php?XID="],a[href*="/profiles.php?XID="]'
    );
    const fromLink=xidFromHref(link?.getAttribute("href"));
    if(fromLink)return fromLink;

      "[data-user-id],[data-xid],[data-user]"
    );
    const dataValue=
      dataElement?.dataset?.userId ||
      dataElement?.dataset?.xid ||
      dataElement?.dataset?.user ||
      dataElement?.getAttribute("data-user-id") ||
      dataElement?.getAttribute("data-xid") ||
      dataElement?.getAttribute("data-user");

      return String(dataValue);
    }
    const html=slotRoot.innerHTML||"";

      /(?:XID=|data-(?:user-id|xid)=["']?)(\d+)/i
    );

  }
  function directSlotItemId(slotRoot) {
    if (!slotRoot) return null;
    const images = Array.from(
      slotRoot.querySelectorAll('img[src*="/images/items/"]')
    );
    for (const image of images) {
      const id = itemIdFromSrc(image.getAttribute("src"));
      if (isAllowedItemId(id)) return String(id);
    }
    const dataItem = slotRoot.querySelector(
      "[data-itemid],[data-item-id]"
    );
    const dataId =
      dataItem?.dataset?.itemid ||
      dataItem?.dataset?.itemId ||
      dataItem?.getAttribute("data-itemid") ||
      dataItem?.getAttribute("data-item-id");
    return isAllowedItemId(dataId) ? String(dataId) : null;
  }
  async function scanCurrentCrimesStage() {
    const stage = getCrimesStageLabel();
    refreshNotInOCFromPage();
    if (stage !== "Recruiting" && stage !== "Planning") {
      return { ok: false, stage, reason: "Not on Recruiting/Planning" };
    }
    const usersInOC = new Set();
    const reqByUser = {};
    const roleByUser = {};
    const roots = findSlotRoots();
    for (const root of roots) {
      let xid = directSlotXid(root);
      if (!xid) {
        xid = await openMenuAndGetXid(root);
      }
      if (!xid) continue;
      usersInOC.add(xid);
      if (!reqByUser[xid]) {
        reqByUser[xid] = [];
      }

      const roleName =
        (
          root.querySelector(
            '[class*="title"], [class*="role"]'
          )?.textContent ||
          ""
        )
          .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
          .trim();

      if (roleName) {
        roleByUser[xid] = roleName;
      }

      let itemId = directSlotItemId(root);
      if (!itemId) {
        const hoverHost =
          root.querySelector(
            'button[class*="slotHeader"],[class*="slotHeader"]'
          ) ||
          root.querySelector('[aria-describedby]') ||
          root;
        const tip = await hoverAndGetTooltip(hoverHost);
        itemId = extractItemIdFromTooltip(tip);
      }
      if (isAllowedItemId(itemId)) {
        const sid = String(itemId);
        if (!reqByUser[xid].includes(sid)) {
          reqByUser[xid].push(sid);
        }
      }
    }
    if (!roots.length || !usersInOC.size) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        stage,
        reason: "No OC role slots found"
      };
    }
    const scan = {
      stage,
      ts: now(),
      source: "dom",
      usersInOC: [...usersInOC],
      reqByUser,
      missingByUser: {},
      roleByUser
    };
    writeScan(scan);
    sessionScanState[stage] = true;
    log("Scan saved:", { stage, users: scan.usersInOC.length });
    return { ok: true, stage, scan };
  }
